name: Гиперэкстензия под углом 45°
description:
Базовое упражнение для поясницы, ягодиц и задней поверхности бедра на скамье для гиперэкстензии под углом 45°.

Техника выполнения:
1. Зафиксируй стопы под валиками и размести бёдра на опоре так, чтобы таз свободно сгибался.
2. Скрести руки на груди или держи их у висков без лишнего напряжения в шее.
3. Сохраняя спину ровной, медленно наклони корпус вниз за счёт сгибания в тазобедренном суставе.
4. За счёт разгибателей спины, ягодиц и бицепса бедра подними корпус обратно до прямой линии тела.
5. Не переразгибай поясницу в верхней точке и выполняй движение подконтрольно.

name: Скручивания «велосипед» под углом 45° (акцент на косые)
description:
Скручивания корпуса в положении под углом 45° с попеременным подтягиванием коленей. Вариант с акцентом на косые мышцы живота и дополнительной нагрузкой на пресс.

Техника выполнения:
1. Ляг на спину, заведи руки за голову и согни ноги в коленях.
2. Подними плечи и стопы от пола, формируя примерно угол 45° между корпусом и ногами.
3. Подтяни правое колено к себе, одновременно поворачивая корпус и тяни левый локоть к правому колену.
4. Затем выпрями правую ногу и повтори движение в другую сторону.
5. Продолжай чередовать стороны плавно, без рывков, сохраняя поясницу прижатой к полу.

name: Скручивания «велосипед» под углом 45° (акцент на пресс)
description:
Скручивания корпуса в положении под углом 45° с попеременной работой ног. В этом варианте основной акцент идёт на прямую мышцу живота, а косые мышцы и сгибатели бедра помогают движению.

Техника выполнения:
1. Ляг на спину, убери руки за голову и согни ноги в коленях.
2. Подними лопатки и стопы от пола, удерживая корпус и ноги под углом около 45°.
3. Подтяни одно колено к груди, одновременно поворачивая корпус навстречу противоположным локтем.
4. Сразу поменяй стороны: выпрями одну ногу и подтяни другую.
5. Выполняй движение в умеренном темпе, не тяни шею руками и не теряй контроль над корпусом.

name: All Fours Groin Stretch
description:
A floor stretch on hands and knees targeting the adductors and groin area.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Start on hands and knees (quadruped position).
2. Slide knees apart, keeping shins and feet in line with knees.
3. Lower hips toward the floor, maintaining a flat back.
4. Move hips back gently until you feel a stretch in the groin.
5. Hold the position and breathe deeply.

Подсказки по технике: Keep spine neutral; Move slowly; Avoid bouncing; Relax into stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Letting feet come together; Overstretching past comfort

Дыхание: Breathe slowly and deeply throughout the stretch.

name: Band Assisted Pull-up
description:
A vertical pulling exercise using a resistance band for assistance to build pull-up strength in the lats, biceps, and upper back.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Loop the band securely over a pull-up bar and place one foot or knee into the bottom of the band.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with your palms facing away from you.
3. Hang with straight arms, tighten your midsection, and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
4. Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
5. Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight again, keeping tension through your torso.

Подсказки по технике: Drive elbows to hips; Keep ribs down; Shoulders away from ears; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Kicking or swinging to get up; Shrugging shoulders up toward the ears; Stopping short with the chin below the bar; Dropping quickly to the bottom without control

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom before you pull, exhale as you pull up, and inhale again as you lower under control.

name: Band Bent-Over Rear Lateral Raise
description:
A rear shoulder and upper back exercise using a resistance band in a bent-over position.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hinge forward at hips, keeping back flat.
3. Hold band with both hands, arms hanging down.
4. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with shoulders.
5. Lower arms back down with control.

Подсказки по технике: Flat back; Slight elbow bend; Squeeze shoulders; Slow control

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding back; Shrugging shoulders; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale during the raise, inhale during the lowering.

name: Band Hip Abduction
description:
A lateral leg movement with a resistance band to activate and strengthen the hip abductor muscles.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Place a resistance band around your thighs or ankles.
2. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
3. Shift weight to one leg.
4. Lift the other leg laterally against band resistance.
5. Return leg to start; repeat on both sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Stable standing leg; Move slowly; Feel glute engagement

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning torso; Poor balance; Letting band snap back

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift leg, inhale as you return.

name: Band Hip Adduction
description:
A resistance band exercise that strengthens the inner thigh muscles through hip adduction.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Secure a resistance band to a sturdy anchor at ankle height.
2. Loop the other end around your working ankle.
3. Stand tall and hold onto a support if needed.
4. Bring your working leg across your body, adducting at the hip.
5. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core tight; Move with control; Avoid swinging; Maintain upright posture

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Rotating hips outward; Bending the standing leg excessively

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull leg inward, inhale as you return.

name: Band Kneeling One Arm Pulldown
description:
A kneeling single-arm band pulldown that trains the lats by pulling the elbow down from an overhead position.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing the anchor point.
2. Grab the band with one hand and extend that arm up and slightly forward.
3. Brace your torso and keep your chest tall without leaning back.
4. Pull your elbow down toward your side until your hand reaches about shoulder or rib level.
5. Squeeze your lat at the bottom while keeping your shoulder down.
6. Slowly straighten your arm back overhead under control.
7. Complete all reps on one side, then switch arms.

Подсказки по технике: Drive elbow to your side; Keep ribs down; Shoulder away from your ear; Move slowly on the return

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning the torso back to finish the pull; Shrugging the shoulder up toward the ear; Bending and straightening the wrist during the pull; Letting the band snap the arm back overhead

Дыхание: Inhale as your arm returns overhead, and exhale as you pull the band down to your side.

name: Band One Arm Front Raise
description:
Isolation shoulder exercise raising one arm forward against band resistance to target the anterior deltoid.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with one foot on the band for resistance.
2. Hold handle in one hand at thigh level, palm facing down.
3. Keep arm straight, raise it forward to shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower arm back down slowly and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Raise to shoulder height; Keep elbow soft; Don't swing; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the arm; Bending at the elbow; Raising above shoulder

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Band One-Leg Kickback (Bent Position)
description:
A glute-focused kickback performed from a bent-over position using a resistance band for added intensity.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band and loop it around your working ankle.
2. Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees bent.
3. Engage your core and extend one leg backward against band resistance.
4. Pause and squeeze the glute at the top.
5. Return to starting position and repeat for desired reps, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back flat; Drive heel upward; Squeeze glutes; Avoid arching lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Sagging the lower back; Rotating the hips; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale as you kick back, inhale as you bring the knee in.

name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
description:
A standing band triceps exercise where you extend your elbows overhead while keeping your upper arms mostly fixed.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand.
2. Raise your hands overhead and bend your elbows so your hands move behind your head.
3. Keep your upper arms close to your ears and brace your midsection.
4. Straighten your elbows to press the band overhead until your arms are fully extended.
5. Pause briefly at the top, then bend your elbows slowly to return behind your head.
6. Repeat without letting your elbows flare wide.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows point forward; Upper arms stay still; Brace your ribs down; Fully straighten the elbows

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare out to the sides; Lower back arches as the band goes overhead; Upper arms drift forward and backward; Only moving partway instead of fully extending

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your hands behind your head, and exhale as you straighten your elbows overhead.

name: Band Prone Leg Curl
description:
A hamstring isolation exercise performed lying face down and flexing the knee using resistance from a band.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band securely at ground level.
2. Lie face down with legs extended.
3. Loop the band around your ankle.
4. Flex your knee, bringing your heel toward your glutes.
5. Slowly return to the start; repeat and switch legs if desired.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips down; Point toes away; Squeeze hamstrings at top; Control lowering phase

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting hips off ground; Using momentum; Letting band snap back

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.

name: Band Pull Through
description:
A banded hip hinge that trains the glutes and hamstrings by pulling the band through the legs as you stand tall.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band at floor level and loop it between your legs.
2. Face away from the anchor and walk forward until the band is taut.
3. Stand with feet about hip-width apart and soften your knees.
4. Push your hips back and hinge forward, letting the band travel behind you.
5. Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch while keeping your back flat.
6. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.

Подсказки по технике: Push hips back; Keep ribs down; Stand tall at top; Squeeze glutes hard

Распространённые ошибки: Squatting down instead of hinging back; Rounding the lower back as you fold forward; Letting the band pull the hips backward at lockout; Bending the knees too much and shifting into the quads

Дыхание: Inhale as you hinge back and exhale as you drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Band Resisted Decline Sit-Up
description:
A decline sit-up performed with band resistance to increase tension on the abdominals.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a resistance band securely behind the decline bench.
2. Lie on the bench with your feet anchored, holding the band at the chest or behind the neck.
3. Engage your core and perform a sit-up, raising your torso towards your knees.
4. Control the movement back down to starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired repetitions.

Подсказки по технике: Keep tension in band; Crunch up slowly; Avoid swinging; Exhale on exertion

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Letting band go slack; Improper anchoring of feet

Дыхание: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Band Seated Leg Extension
description:
A seated exercise using a resistance band to isolate and strengthen the quadriceps.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat.
2. Anchor one end of a band behind the chair leg.
3. Loop the other end of the band around your ankle.
4. Raise your lower leg to extend the knee fully.
5. Lower the leg back down under control; repeat and switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Sit tall; Keep upper leg stationary; Control extension; Do not lock knee at top

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the leg; Allowing the knee to drift or twist; Arching back

Дыхание: Exhale as you extend, inhale as you return.

name: Band Seated Row
description:
Seated row using resistance bands that targets the mid-back and lats.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the floor with legs straight and loop the band over your feet.
2. Grab the band handles or ends with both hands, arms extended.
3. Keep back straight and chest up.
4. Pull the handles back, driving elbows past your torso and squeezing shoulder blades.
5. Release slowly to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with elbows; Keep chest up; Squeeze shoulder blades; Don't round your back

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the back; Using momentum; Letting band slack between reps

Дыхание: Exhale as you row, inhale as you return to start.

name: Band Shoulder Warm-Up Stretch
description:
A shoulder stretch and mobility drill using a resistance band to warm up the deltoids and rotator cuff.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall and grip band with hands wider than shoulders.
2. Hold arms straight, band in front of thighs.
3. Slowly raise band overhead while keeping arms straight.
4. Move band behind head and down to lower back.
5. Reverse the movement to bring band to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms straight; Move slowly; Stay within pain-free range; Keep posture tall

Распространённые ошибки: Bending arms; Rushing the movement; Arching lower back

Дыхание: Breathe naturally throughout stretch.

name: Band Side Bend
description:
A standing lateral bend using a resistance band to target and strengthen the oblique muscles.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the resistance band securely at ground level.
2. Stand beside the anchor point, feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Hold the band handle with the outside hand, arm extended alongside your body.
4. Keeping your torso straight, bend sideways at the waist away from the anchor.
5. Return to the starting position and repeat for reps, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Don’t rotate hips; Bend directly to the side; Controlled return

Распространённые ошибки: Rotating the torso instead of bending laterally; Bending forward or backward; Letting the band snap back; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale while bending, inhale on the return.

name: Band Standing Calf Raise
description:
Standing calf raise performed with a resistance band to strengthen the calves.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width on the band.
2. Hold band handles by sides or at shoulders for resistance.
3. Keep torso upright and brace core.
4. Raise heels to stand on the balls of your feet, contracting calves.
5. Lower heels back to the floor slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Go all the way up; Pause at the top; Lower slowly; Keep core engaged

Распространённые ошибки: Partial reps; Letting heels drop too quickly; Leaning forward or backward

Дыхание: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.

name: Band Standing Crunch
description:
A standing abdominal crunch using a resistance band to train the abs and obliques through spinal flexion.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach the band to an anchor around waist height and stand facing away from it.
2. Hold the band at your chest with both hands and step forward until the band is taut.
3. Set your feet about hip-width apart and soften your knees.
4. Brace your midsection and curl your ribs down, bending your torso forward.
5. Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping your hips mostly still.
6. Slowly uncurl your torso and return to an upright position under control.

Подсказки по технике: Ribs down; Curl through your spine; Keep hips still; Move slowly both ways

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling the band with the arms instead of curling the torso.; Hinging at the hips like a bow instead of rounding into a crunch.; Letting the band snap the torso back upright.; Standing too close to the anchor so the band has no tension.

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch forward, and inhale as you return to standing.

name: Band Standing Leg Curl
description:
A standing hamstring curl variation using resistance from a band for leg flexion.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the resistance band behind you at ground level.
2. Loop the band around one ankle.
3. Stand on the opposite leg and balance.
4. Curl your heel toward your glutes by flexing your knee.
5. Lower leg slowly; repeat and switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep thighs aligned; Stay tall; Squeeze hamstrings; Control descent

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees move forward; Using back to assist; Letting band snap

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you return.

name: Band Standing Lift
description:
A diagonal band movement to train the obliques and core stabilizers.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band low near the floor.
2. Stand side-on to the anchor, feet shoulder-width.
3. Hold the band handle with both hands at hip level.
4. Lift and rotate your torso diagonally to the opposite side and above shoulder.
5. Return to start; repeat, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms mostly straight; Twist from the core; Pivot feet for rotation; Do not hyperextend back

Распространённые ошибки: Using arms instead of core; Not rotating torso; Bending elbows excessively

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift/rotate, inhale as you return.

name: Band Standing Rear Delt Row
description:
A bent-over band row with elbows flared out to target the rear delts and upper back.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand on the middle of the band with feet about hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand.
2. Hinge forward at the hips with a soft bend in your knees until your torso leans forward and your arms hang below your shoulders.
3. Set your shoulders down and keep your chest open with your palms facing each other or slightly inward.
4. Pull your elbows out and back until your hands reach around lower chest to upper rib level.
5. Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the top without shrugging.
6. Lower your hands back down under control until your arms are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Keep neck long; Chest open, back flat; Don’t shrug up

Распространённые ошибки: Standing too upright and turning it into a regular row; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears at the top; Pulling the hands too low toward the waist; Rounding the upper or lower back while hinging

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower to the start, and exhale as you row the band up.

name: Band Straight-Back Seated Row
description:
A banded rowing movement emphasizing the upper back and lats while seated with a straight torso.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the floor and extend your legs forward.
2. Loop the band around your feet securely.
3. Grip the band handles with both hands, arms extended.
4. Keeping your back straight, pull the handles toward your waist, elbows close to your body.
5. Pause, squeeze your shoulder blades, then slowly return to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Maintain neutral spine; Squeeze shoulder blades; Control the release

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding your back; Letting arms flare out; Using momentum rather than back muscles

Дыхание: Exhale as you row, inhale as you return to start.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
description:
An isolation triceps exercise using an overhead-anchored band to straighten the elbows against resistance.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it with a handle or end in each hand.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and pin your upper arms close to your sides.
3. Brace your torso and press your hands straight down until your elbows fully extend.
4. Pause briefly at the bottom and squeeze your triceps.
5. Slowly let the band rise back up until your forearms return to the start position.
6. Repeat without letting your elbows drift forward or outward.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows pinned to sides; Only move the forearms; Stand tall; Squeeze at lockout

Распространённые ошибки: Upper arms swinging forward and back; Elbows flaring away from the torso; Leaning body weight onto the band; Stopping short of full elbow extension

Дыхание: Exhale as you press the band down, and inhale as you return to the start.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description:
Classic compound lower body lift with barbell across traps, targeting quads and glutes.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Position barbell on upper traps, unrack.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Descend into squat keeping back neutral.
4. Lower until thighs parallel or below.
5. Drive up through heels to standing.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Back straight; Drive through heels; Knees track over toes

Распространённые ошибки: Knees caving in; Rounding lower back; Heels lifting off floor

Дыхание: Inhale lowering, exhale rising.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description:
A flat bench press using a barbell to train the chest, triceps, and shoulders with a horizontal pressing motion.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on the bench with your eyes under the bar and plant your feet firmly on the floor.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and straighten your arms to unrack it over your chest.
3. Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest while keeping your wrists stacked over your forearms.
4. Lightly touch your chest, then press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
5. Guide the bar back into the rack once you finish the set.

Подсказки по технике: Drive feet into floor; Keep wrists stacked; Touch mid-chest; Press straight up

Распространённые ошибки: Bar drifts toward the neck or stomach; Elbows flare straight out from the shoulders; Wrists bend backward under the bar; Hips lift off the bench during the press

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar to your chest, and exhale as you press it back up.

name: Barbell Clean And Press
description:
A full-body barbell lift that moves the bar from the floor to the shoulders, then presses it overhead.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart and place the barbell over your midfoot.
2. Bend at your hips and knees, grip the bar just outside your legs, and set your back flat with your chest up.
3. Push the floor away and lift the bar, keeping it close to your shins and thighs as you stand.
4. Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, then shrug and pull yourself under the bar.
5. Catch the bar on the fronts of your shoulders with elbows forward and stand tall.
6. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are locked out and the bar is over your shoulders.
7. Lower the bar back to your shoulders, then guide it down to the floor under control.

Подсказки по технике: Keep the bar close; Drive through the floor; Elbows fast through; Press straight overhead

Распространённые ошибки: Starting with the bar too far in front of the feet; Rounding the lower back when pulling from the floor; Catching the bar with elbows low and chest collapsed; Pressing the bar forward instead of overhead

Дыхание: Inhale and brace before pulling from the floor, then exhale as you press overhead and reset your breath before the next rep.

name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
description:
Bench press variation with close grip targeting triceps along with chest and shoulders.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on bench and grasp barbell with close grip.
2. Unrack and position bar above lower chest.
3. Lower bar slowly, elbows close to sides.
4. Touch chest briefly, then press bar to starting position.
5. Repeat for reps.

Подсказки по технике: Tuck elbows; Grip just inside shoulder width; Press through triceps; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Gripping too narrow or wide; Elbows flaring out; Bouncing bar on chest

Дыхание: Exhale pressing up, inhale lowering bar.

name: Barbell Curl
description:
A standing biceps exercise where you curl a barbell from your thighs to shoulder height with an underhand grip.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold the barbell at your thighs with an underhand grip.
2. Set your shoulders back, brace your torso, and keep your elbows pinned by your sides.
3. Curl the bar upward by bending your elbows until the bar reaches about shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps without letting your elbows drift forward.
5. Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs until your arms are straight.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay by your sides; Lift with the biceps; Keep wrists straight; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to start the bar moving; Letting the elbows drift forward as the bar rises; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral; Dropping the bar quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the bar up, and inhale as you lower it back down under control.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
description:
A decline barbell press done on a downward-angled bench to train the chest, triceps, and shoulders through a pressing pattern.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on the decline bench and secure your legs under the pads with your eyes under the bar.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and pull your shoulder blades back into the bench.
3. Unrack the bar and hold it above your lower chest with straight wrists and locked elbows.
4. Lower the bar under control to your lower chest or upper sternum while keeping your elbows at about a 45-degree angle.
5. Press the bar straight up until your elbows are extended and the bar returns over your lower chest.
6. Repeat each rep with the same bar path and controlled tempo.

Подсказки по технике: Drive shoulders into bench; Wrists stacked over forearms; Lower to lower chest; Press straight up

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing the bar off the chest; Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Letting the wrists bend back under the bar; Pressing the bar toward the face instead of over the chest

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar to your chest, and exhale as you press it back up.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
description:
A barbell biceps curl variation where the bar stays close to the torso and the elbows move back as you lift.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart and hold the barbell with an underhand grip at your thighs.
2. Pull your shoulders slightly back and keep your elbows behind your torso.
3. Curl the bar upward by sliding it close along the front of your body as your elbows travel back.
4. Lift until the bar reaches your upper stomach or lower chest without letting it drift away from you.
5. Lower the barbell slowly along the same path until your arms are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep the bar close; Drive elbows back; Chest tall; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the bar swing forward away from the body; Bending the wrists back as the bar rises; Rocking the torso to start the curl; Flaring the elbows out to the sides

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you drag-curl the bar up, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Barbell Front Raise
description:
A shoulder isolation exercise where you lift a barbell straight in front of your body to train the front delts.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold the barbell against your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
3. Raise the barbell straight forward in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly without shrugging your shoulders.
5. Lower the barbell back to your thighs with control.
6. Reset your posture and repeat the movement.

Подсказки по технике: Lift to shoulder height; Keep ribs down; Lead with your hands; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning back to start the lift.; Swinging the barbell with the hips.; Raising the barbell above shoulder height.; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the barbell, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Barbell Front Squat
description:
Squat variation with barbell held at the front rack position, targeting the quadriceps.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Rack barbell at collarbone level, elbows up.
2. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Descend into squat keeping torso upright.
4. Lower until thighs are parallel to floor.
5. Drive up through heels to stand.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows high; Torso upright; Heels down; Keep knees tracking over toes

Распространённые ошибки: Letting elbows drop; Rounding back; Heels lifting off floor

Дыхание: Inhale when lowering, exhale standing up.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
description:
A pressing exercise on an incline bench using a barbell to train the upper chest, shoulders, and triceps.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and lie back with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with straight wrists and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
3. Unrack the bar and hold it above your upper chest with your arms straight.
4. Lower the bar under control to your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked from straight out.
5. Press the bar upward until your arms are straight again, keeping the bar path over your shoulders.
6. Rack the bar back onto the supports with control after your final rep.

Подсказки по технике: Drive feet into floor; Keep chest up; Wrists stacked over elbows; Press straight up

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Bouncing the bar off the chest; Lifting the feet or shifting on the bench; Lowering the bar to the neck or stomach

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar to your chest, and exhale as you press it back up.

name: Barbell Lunge
description:
A lower-body lunge with a barbell on your upper back that trains the glutes, quads, and hamstrings one leg at a time.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the barbell across your upper back and stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
2. Brace your core and take a controlled step forward with one foot.
3. Lower your body until both knees bend and your back knee moves toward the floor.
4. Keep your front foot flat and your torso upright at the bottom position.
5. Push through the front foot to stand back up and bring your feet together.
6. Repeat on the other side, alternating legs each rep.

Подсказки по технике: Stay tall; Front heel stays down; Track knees over toes; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Taking such a short step that the front knee shoots far past the toes.; Leaning the torso forward as you lower.; Letting the front knee cave inward.; Pushing off the back foot instead of driving through the front foot.

Дыхание: Inhale as you step forward and lower down, then exhale as you push back to standing.

name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
description:
A chest-supported biceps curl on an incline bench using a barbell to isolate elbow flexion with minimal body swing.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and lie face down with your chest supported and your feet planted on the floor.
2. Hold the barbell with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart and let your arms hang straight down.
3. Brace your torso against the bench and keep your upper arms still.
4. Curl the barbell upward by bending your elbows until the bar reaches near the front of your shoulders.
5. Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top without lifting your chest off the bench.
6. Lower the barbell under control until your elbows are fully extended again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows pinned; Curl, don't swing; Chest stays on bench; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the chest off the bench to help the bar up; Letting the elbows drift forward during the curl; Using body swing or kicking the legs to create momentum; Dropping the bar quickly instead of lowering it under control

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you curl the bar up, and inhale again as you lower it back down.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
description:
A bent-over barbell raise that targets the rear delts by lifting the arms out to the sides while holding a barbell.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall holding the barbell with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
2. Soften your knees and hinge at your hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
3. Let the bar hang below your chest with your arms straight and your neck neutral.
4. Raise the bar out and up by moving your upper arms to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso still.
6. Lower the bar under control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Hinge, don't round; Lead with your elbows; Keep neck neutral; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as you hinge forward; Swinging the torso to heave the bar upward; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Turning it into a row by bending the elbows too much

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar and set your hinge, then exhale as you raise the bar out to the sides.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description:
A wrist flexion exercise performed with a pronated grip to target the forearm extensors.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench and grasp a barbell with an overhand (pronated) grip.
2. Rest your forearms on your thighs with wrists hanging just beyond your knees.
3. Begin with your wrists flexed downward.
4. Slowly curl your wrists upward, lifting the barbell.
5. Lower under control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep forearms stationary; Use slow, controlled motion; Only wrists should move; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Using too much weight; Lifting with elbows or shoulders; Letting the barbell roll in hands

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the bar up, inhale as you lower.

name: Barbell Seated Behind-The-Neck Press
description:
A shoulder press variation performed seated with a barbell lowered behind the neck to target the deltoids.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench with back support; grip barbell wider than shoulders.
2. Unrack barbell and hold above your head.
3. Lower barbell behind your head to just below ear level.
4. Press barbell back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back upright; Don't arch lower back; Lower bar with control; Use full range

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring elbows excessively; Arching lower back; Lowering bar too far

Дыхание: Exhale when pressing up, inhale when lowering the bar.

name: Barbell Shrug
description:
A standing trap exercise where you hold a barbell at your thighs and lift your shoulders straight up and down.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
2. Let your arms hang straight, brace your torso, and keep your chest up.
3. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows or leaning back.
4. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your upper traps.
5. Lower your shoulders under control until they return to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Shoulders straight up; Arms stay long; Chest tall; No rolling

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows to curl the bar upward.; Rolling the shoulders forward or backward at the top.; Leaning back and swinging the torso to move the bar.; Letting the head jut forward as the shoulders rise.

Дыхание: Inhale before each rep, exhale as you shrug your shoulders up, and inhale as you lower back down.

name: Barbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
description:
A standing forearm exercise where you hold a barbell behind your body and lift it by curling only your wrists.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and hold a barbell behind your hips with an overhand grip.
2. Let the bar rest across your fingers so your knuckles face the floor and your palms face behind you.
3. Keep your elbows close to your sides and straighten your wrists to lower the bar toward your fingertips.
4. Curl your wrists upward to roll the bar back into your hands and lift it as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top, then lower the bar with control back to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Move only your wrists; Keep elbows pinned back; Use full wrist range; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the bar with the shoulders or torso; Bending the elbows to lift the bar; Letting the bar slip too far out of the hands; Using short, jerky wrist motions

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar toward your fingertips, and exhale as you curl your wrists up.

name: Barbell Straight Leg Deadlift
description:
A barbell hip hinge that trains the hamstrings and glutes by lowering the bar down the legs with minimal knee bend.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your thighs with straight arms.
2. Soften your knees slightly and brace your midsection.
3. Push your hips back and lower the bar down your legs while keeping your back flat and your legs nearly straight.
4. Lower until the bar reaches mid-shin or until you feel a strong hamstring stretch without losing your back position.
5. Drive your hips forward and stand tall, keeping the bar close to your legs the whole way up.
6. Finish with your hips locked out and shoulders stacked over your hips.

Подсказки по технике: Hips back, not down; Keep the bar close; Soft knees, flat back; Stand tall and squeeze glutes

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the knees into a squat as the bar lowers; Letting the bar drift forward away from the legs; Rounding the lower back near the bottom; Jerking the bar off the bottom instead of lifting smoothly

Дыхание: Inhale and brace before hinging down, then exhale as you drive your hips forward to stand up.

name: Barbell Underhand Bent-Over Row
description:
Row performed bent over with barbell and an underhand (supinated) grip, targeting lats and biceps.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on floor.
2. Bend forward from hips, back straight, grasp bar underhand.
3. Let bar hang at arm’s length below shoulders.
4. Row barbell to torso, elbows close to sides.
5. Lower barbell under control to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back flat; Pull with elbows; Squeeze shoulder blades; Keep wrists neutral

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding lower back; Flaring elbows excessively; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale as you row up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
description:
A compound barbell lift with a wide grip to target the shoulders and upper back.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright with feet shoulder width apart.
2. Hold the barbell using a wide, overhand grip.
3. Let the bar rest in front of your thighs.
4. Lift the bar straight up toward your chest, elbows out to the sides.
5. Lower the bar slowly to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Keep bar close to your body; Stop at upper chest; Maintain neutral spine

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging shoulders excessively; Using too much momentum; Hands too close

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Battling Ropes
description:
A rope conditioning exercise using alternating arm waves to train the shoulders, forearms, and core.

Оборудование: канат

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor your stance with feet about shoulder-width apart and bend your knees slightly.
2. Hold one rope end in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms in front of you.
3. Brace your core and lift one hand as you lower the other to start the waves.
4. Keep alternating your arms quickly to send continuous waves down the ropes.
5. Maintain the slight knee bend and steady torso as you keep the waves even.

Подсказки по технике: Move arms fast; Keep chest tall; Brace your core; Make even waves

Распространённые ошибки: Standing upright with locked knees; Swinging the whole torso instead of the arms; Letting the waves become uneven or stop; Lifting the shoulders up toward the ears

Дыхание: Breathe steadily throughout, exhaling with the arm drive and inhaling as the arms switch.

name: Bench Crunch
description:
An abdominal crunch performed lying on a flat or decline bench to isolate the abs.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench with knees bent and feet secured or flat.
2. Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head.
3. Engage your core and lift your shoulders towards your knees.
4. Squeeze at the top and hold briefly.
5. Lower your upper body back to bench in a controlled manner.

Подсказки по технике: Lift with your abs; Keep chin tucked; Don't arch back; Control the motion

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling on neck; Rushing reps; Lifting too high

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Bench Dips
description:
Bench dips are a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps by lowering and raising the body using a bench for support.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench and place your hands beside your hips, gripping the edge.
2. Extend your legs out in front with heels on the floor.
3. Slide your hips off the bench, supporting your weight with your arms.
4. Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
5. Push through your palms to extend your elbows and return to the start.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows close to body; Lower slowly and with control; Keep chest tall; Avoid shrugging shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Allowing elbows to flare out; Shrugging shoulders upward; Dropping hips too low

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you press upward.

name: Bench Pull-Up
description:
A pull-up variation using a bench for foot support to reduce load and assist the movement.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Place a bench under a pull-up bar.
2. Grip the bar with hands wider than shoulder-width.
3. Position feet on the bench for support.
4. Pull your chest towards the bar, using feet as needed.
5. Lower yourself slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core engaged; Lead with chest; Pull elbows down and back; Don't let legs push too much

Распространённые ошибки: Using too much leg drive; Swinging body or kicking feet; Chin barely reaching bar; Not controlling descent

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Bent Knee Lying Twist on Stability Ball
originalName: Bent Knee Lying Twist on Stability Ball
description:
A rotational stretch on a stability ball that targets the obliques and hip flexors.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with calves on a stability ball.
2. Extend arms out at your sides for support.
3. Bend knees at 90 degrees over the ball.
4. Slowly drop knees to one side, keeping shoulders flat.
5. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep shoulders grounded; Control the twist; Engage core; Move slowly

Распространённые ошибки: Letting shoulders lift off floor; Moving too quickly; Over-twisting hips

Дыхание: Exhale as you twist, inhale returning to center.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
description:
A yoga pose that stretches and activates the glutes, lower back, and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
2. Place your arms at your sides, palms down.
3. Press through your heels and lift your hips upward.
4. Hold the pose, engaging your glutes and core.
5. Lower your hips back to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Squeeze glutes at the top; Keep knees aligned with hips; Do not overarch lower back; Press evenly through feet

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the back excessively; Letting knees fall outward or inward; Not engaging the core

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
description:
Bridge Pose is a yoga stretch that lifts the hips to activate the glutes and open the chest and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
2. Place arms alongside your body, palms down.
3. Press into your heels to lift your hips off the floor, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders.
4. Engage your glutes and hold the top position for several seconds.
5. Lower your hips back down in a controlled motion.

Подсказки по технике: Press through heels; Squeeze glutes at the top; Keep knees aligned; Avoid over-arching lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees flare outward; Overarching lower back; Not engaging glutes

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

name: Burpee
description:
A full-body bodyweight movement that combines a squat, plank, push-up, and jump for conditioning.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Bend your knees, hinge at your hips, and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
3. Jump both feet back to a high plank with your body in a straight line.
4. Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up to plank.
5. Jump both feet forward to the outside of your hands.
6. Drive through your feet and jump straight up, reaching your arms overhead as you leave the floor.
7. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Keep your core braced.; Land softly under control.; Chest up on the jump.; Move as one straight line.

Распространённые ошибки: Hips sagging low in the plank or push-up.; Feet landing too narrow under the body.; Hands placed far in front of the shoulders.; Landing stiff-legged with no knee bend.

Дыхание: Inhale as you drop down and move into plank, then exhale as you press up and jump.

name: Butterfly Yoga Pose
description:
A seated stretch that opens the hips and groin by bringing the feet together and letting the knees fall outward.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit upright with feet together and knees bent out to sides.
2. Hold your feet with your hands.
3. Keep spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
4. Gently press knees toward the floor.
5. Hold the position, breathing deeply.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest tall; Relax the hips; Don't force knees down; Engage core lightly

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the back; Bouncing knees; Forcing knees down

Дыхание: Breathe evenly throughout the stretch.

name: Cable Close Grip Lat Pulldown
description:
A cable exercise using a close grip to target the latissimus dorsi and supporting back muscles.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a V-bar or close grip handle to the cable machine.
2. Sit down and secure your thighs under the pads.
3. Grasp the handle with a neutral grip, hands parallel.
4. Pull the handle down to the top of your chest, keeping torso vertical.
5. Slowly return the handle to the top without locking elbows.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Keep chest up; Do not swing back; Squeeze lats at bottom

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning back excessively; Using momentum; Not fully engaging lats; Rounding shoulders forward

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return up.

name: Cable Crossover Reverse Fly
description:
A cable rear-delt fly where you pull crossed low handles out and back to train the back of the shoulders and upper back.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set both cable handles to the low pulleys and stand centered between them.
2. Grab the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left hand, then step forward to create tension.
3. Hinge forward slightly with a soft bend in your knees and keep your chest up and back flat.
4. Start with your arms angled down and crossed in front of you, elbows slightly bent.
5. Pull both arms out and back in a wide arc until your hands reach about shoulder height.
6. Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the end position.
7. Return the handles slowly to the start without shrugging or changing your torso position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Keep a soft elbow bend; Chest up, back flat; Don't shrug your shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Standing fully upright and turning it into a row; Bending and straightening the elbows during the rep; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Swinging the torso to move the handles

Дыхание: Inhale as you return the handles to the start, and exhale as you pull your arms out and back.

name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
description:
A kneeling cable ab exercise where you curl your torso downward against a high pulley to train the abs and obliques.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a rope handle to the high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
2. Grab the rope ends and bring your hands beside your head with your elbows slightly forward.
3. Brace your midsection and keep your hips stacked over your knees.
4. Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis and bring your elbows down toward your thighs.
5. Pause briefly in the bottom position while keeping tension on the rope.
6. Slowly uncurl your spine and return to the start without letting the weight stack slam.

Подсказки по технике: Ribs to hips; Hips stay still; Curl, don't hinge; Keep neck neutral

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling the rope down with the arms instead of curling the torso; Sitting hips back and turning it into a hip hinge; Jerking up and letting the weight stack drop between reps; Lifting the chest too high and losing abdominal tension at the top

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl down into the crunch, and inhale as you slowly return to the starting position.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description:
A single-arm cable shoulder isolation exercise that raises the arm out to the side to target the lateral delts.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the cable at the lowest position and stand side-on to it.
2. Grab the handle with the outside hand and let your arm hang by your thigh.
3. Stand tall with a slight bend in your elbow and brace your midline.
4. Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder height.
5. Pause briefly without shrugging your shoulder.
6. Lower the handle back down with control to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbow; Stop at shoulder height; Keep neck relaxed; Raise with control

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulder up toward the ear; Swinging the torso to lift the handle; Turning the raise into a front lift; Lifting the hand far above shoulder height

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the handle to the side, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
description:
A lying cable triceps exercise where you bend and straighten the elbows to move a rope handle over your chest.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a rope handle to a low cable and place a flat bench in line with the pulley.
2. Lie face up on the bench with your head closest to the cable and hold the rope with a neutral grip.
3. Press the rope straight above your chest with your arms fully extended.
4. Keep your upper arms mostly still and bend your elbows to lower the rope toward your forehead.
5. Pause briefly when your elbows are deeply bent.
6. Straighten your elbows to return the rope to the start position above your chest.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay tucked; Upper arms stay still; Move only at the elbows; Finish with straight arms

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the elbows flare wide to the sides; Drifting the upper arms backward and turning it into a pullover; Lowering the rope behind the head instead of toward the forehead; Bouncing out of the bottom instead of controlling the cable

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the rope toward your forehead, and exhale as you straighten your elbows back to the start.

name: Cable One Arm Curl
description:
A single-arm cable biceps exercise where you curl a handle upward while keeping your elbow tucked at your side.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand beside the cable machine and hold the handle in one hand with your palm facing up.
2. Step out until the cable is taut, then stand tall with your elbow tucked against your side.
3. Curl the handle upward by bending your elbow without letting your upper arm drift forward.
4. Raise the handle until your forearm is close to your biceps, then briefly squeeze your arm.
5. Lower the handle slowly until your arm is straight again while keeping tension on the cable.
6. Complete all reps on one arm, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbow pinned; Palm stays up; Stand tall; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Elbow swings forward during the curl; Shoulder shrugs up toward the ear; Torso leans back to move the weight; Handle drops quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the handle up, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Cable One Arm Front Raise
description:
An isolation exercise that raises the arm forward using a cable to target the front deltoid.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach handle to low pulley and stand facing away from machine.
2. Grasp handle with one hand, arm by your side.
3. With a straight arm, raise it forward to shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower back to the start slowly and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core tight; Lift with shoulder, not hand; Don't swing; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Shrugging shoulder; Overextending at the top

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Cable One Arm Lateral Pulldown
description:
A vertical pulling exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi using a single cable handle.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a single handle to the high cable pulley.
2. Sit or stand, arm overhead grasping the handle.
3. Stabilize your body and engage your core.
4. Pull handle down to shoulder/upper chest level.
5. Pause, then return handle slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Pull elbow down and in; Don’t shrug shoulders; Keep torso upright; Focus on the lats

Распространённые ошибки: Arching back excessively; Letting shoulder roll forward; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale while pulling down, inhale while releasing.

name: Cable One Arm Lateral Raise
description:
A single-arm shoulder isolation exercise using a cable to lift the arm out to the side and target the lateral delts.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand sideways to the cable machine and grasp the handle with the outside hand.
2. Step away until the cable is taut, with your arm down by your side and a slight bend in your elbow.
3. Brace your torso and keep your shoulders level.
4. Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches about shoulder height.
5. Pause briefly without shrugging your shoulder.
6. Lower the handle back down with control to the starting position.
7. Complete the reps on one side, then switch arms.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbow; Keep shoulders level; Raise to shoulder height; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the working shoulder toward the ear; Swinging the torso to start the rep; Turning the raise into a front raise; Lifting the hand far above shoulder height

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise your arm to the side, and inhale as you lower it back down under control.

name: Cable One-Arm Twisting Seated Row
description:
A unilateral cable row variation adding torso rotation to activate both the lats and core.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the cable row bench and grasp a single handle with one hand.
2. Keep back straight and feet planted on the platform.
3. Pull the handle toward your torso while rotating your shoulder and upper body toward the working side.
4. Pause and squeeze your back muscles at contraction.
5. Slowly return arm and torso to the starting position with control.

Подсказки по технике: Rotate torso with row; Keep chest up; Avoid jerking; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Over-rotating; Using momentum; Shrugging the shoulder

Дыхание: Exhale as you row and rotate, inhale as you extend and return.

name: Cable Pulldown
description:
A seated cable back exercise where you pull a bar from overhead to your upper chest to train the lats and upper arms.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and knee pad so your thighs are held down and you can reach the bar overhead.
2. Sit tall with your feet flat, grab the bar with an overhand grip just outside shoulder width, and straighten your arms.
3. Lean back slightly and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
4. Drive your elbows down and pull the bar to the top of your chest.
5. Pause briefly while keeping your chest lifted and your torso still.
6. Slowly straighten your arms and let the bar rise under control to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Pull elbows to your ribs; Keep chest tall; Shoulders down, not shrugged; Control the way up

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling the bar behind the neck; Swinging the torso backward to start the rep; Letting the shoulders shrug up at the top; Stopping short and not fully straightening the arms

Дыхание: Inhale as the bar rises, and exhale as you pull the bar down to your upper chest.

name: Cable Rear Delt Row (with rope)
description:
A cable rowing variation with a rope that targets the rear delts by pulling the elbows out and back.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a rope to a low cable pulley and stand facing the machine.
2. Grab the rope with both hands, step back to create tension, and set your feet about hip-width apart.
3. Soften your knees and hinge forward slightly with a flat back and arms extended in front of you.
4. Lead with your elbows and row the rope up toward your upper chest while letting the rope ends separate.
5. Pause briefly as your elbows travel out and back and your shoulder blades squeeze together.
6. Lower the rope under control until your arms are extended again without rounding your shoulders.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Chest up, back flat; Pull shoulders back; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Standing fully upright and turning it into a regular cable row; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears during the pull; Pulling mostly with the hands and curling the rope in; Rounding the upper back as the rope returns forward

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the rope forward, and exhale as you row the rope toward your upper chest.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
description:
An isolation exercise using a rope attachment on a high pulley to target the triceps overhead.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a rope to a high pulley.
2. Stand (or kneel) with back facing the machine.
3. Grasp rope, step forward, and lean slightly.
4. Keep upper arms still, extend elbows bringing rope forward/upward.
5. Return to starting position slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Keep upper arms stationary; Elbows close; Extend fully; Avoid arching back

Распространённые ошибки: Moving upper arms; Flaring elbows; Arching or swinging back

Дыхание: Exhale as you extend, inhale as you bend elbows.

name: Cable Rope Triceps Pushdown
description:
A cable isolation exercise targeting the triceps by pressing a rope attachment downward.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a rope to the high pulley and stand facing the machine.
2. Grab the rope with both hands, thumbs facing inward.
3. Keep elbows tucked at your sides and lean slightly forward.
4. Extend your arms down, splitting the rope at the bottom.
5. Slowly return to the start without letting elbows flare out.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows fixed; Split the rope at the bottom; Don’t use your shoulders; Full extension on each rep

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring elbows; Using momentum; Not fully extending arms

Дыхание: Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return.

name: Cable Seated High Row (V-bar)
description:
A seated cable row using a V-bar handle, pulling toward the upper torso to train the lats, upper back, and biceps.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit at the cable row station facing the stack and grasp the V-bar handle with a neutral grip.
2. Plant your feet, soften your knees, and sit tall with your chest up and arms extended.
3. Brace your torso and pull your shoulder blades back and down.
4. Drive your elbows back and out slightly as you row the handle toward your upper stomach or lower chest.
5. Pause briefly with the handle close to your torso and your shoulders pulled back.
6. Extend your arms forward under control until your shoulders are stretched, then repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Lead with the elbows; Squeeze shoulder blades; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as the handle moves forward; Leaning far back and using body swing to pull; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Pulling with the arms only and not moving the shoulder blades

Дыхание: Inhale as you extend your arms forward, and exhale as you row the handle toward your torso.

name: Cable Standing Crunch
description:
A standing cable ab exercise where you curl your torso downward against a high pulley to train the abs and obliques.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set a cable at the high pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
2. Hold the attachment by the sides of your head with both hands and bend your knees slightly.
3. Brace your midsection and keep your hips mostly still.
4. Curl your ribcage down toward your pelvis, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
5. Pause briefly in the bottom position and squeeze your abs.
6. Slowly uncurl your torso back to the start without letting the weight stack slam.

Подсказки по технике: Ribs to hips; Keep hips still; Curl, don't hinge; Brace your abs

Распространённые ошибки: Hinging forward at the hips instead of curling the spine; Pulling the attachment down with the arms; Standing too upright and barely moving the torso; Letting the weight yank the torso back up

Дыхание: Inhale at the top, exhale as you curl down, and inhale again as you return under control.

name: Cable Standing Fly
description:
A cable isolation exercise for the chest, performed standing and moving arms in a hugging motion.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach handles to both high pulleys.
2. Stand centered between pulleys, grasp handles in each hand.
3. Step forward into a staggered stance, arms outstretched.
4. With elbows slightly bent, bring handles together in front of chest.
5. Return slowly to starting position, feeling the stretch in the chest.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Slight bend at elbows; Keep chest up; Don’t let shoulders roll forward

Распространённые ошибки: Over-extending arms; Letting elbows lock; Rounding the back

Дыхание: Exhale as you bring hands together, inhale as you return.

name: Cable Standing Inner Curl
description:
A single-arm cable biceps curl done standing with an underhand grip to train elbow flexion under constant tension.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set a cable handle to the lowest position and stand facing the machine.
2. Grab the handle with one hand using an underhand grip and let your arm hang straight by your side.
3. Step back until the cable is taut, then stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
4. Keep your elbow pinned near your side and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your upper arm drift forward.
6. Lower the handle slowly until your arm is straight again, then repeat before switching sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbow by your side; Curl, don't swing; Stand tall; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Elbow drifts forward during the curl; Torso rocks back to move the weight; Wrist bends excessively instead of staying neutral; Letting the handle drop quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the handle up, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Cable Standing Lift
description:
A standing cable core exercise that lifts the handle diagonally across the body to train the abs and obliques.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the cable handle to a low position and stand side-on to the machine with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the handle with both hands near the hip closest to the machine and straighten your arms with a soft bend in the elbows.
3. Brace your core and turn your chest slightly toward the handle without rounding your back.
4. Pull the handle diagonally up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder by rotating your torso and lifting your arms together.
5. Pause briefly at the top with your hips mostly facing forward and your arms extended.
6. Lower the handle back along the same diagonal path to the starting hip under control.
7. Complete all reps on one side, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Brace your core; Rotate through your torso; Keep arms long; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows and turning it into an arm pull; Twisting the knees inward instead of rotating the torso; Leaning back or arching the lower back at the top; Letting the weight snap back down without control

Дыхание: Inhale at the start, exhale as you lift and rotate across the body, then inhale as you return under control.

name: Cable Standing One Arm Triceps Extension
originalName: Cable Standing One Arm Triceps Extension
description:
A single-arm cable triceps isolation exercise done standing, extending the elbow while keeping the upper arm fixed.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand side-on to the cable machine and grasp the handle with one hand.
2. Step away until the cable is taut, then raise your upper arm so it stays roughly parallel to the floor.
3. Bend your elbow to bring the handle toward the side of your head while keeping your upper arm still.
4. Extend your elbow to press the handle away until your arm is straight.
5. Pause briefly with your triceps tight, then return under control.
6. Complete all reps on one side, then switch arms.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbow still; Upper arm stays level; Straighten the arm fully; Move only at elbow

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the elbow drift up and down during the rep; Turning the torso to help move the handle; Dropping the upper arm instead of keeping it level; Using momentum and snapping the cable back

Дыхание: Inhale as you bend your elbow and bring the handle in; exhale as you straighten your arm.

name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown
description:
A cable lat exercise where you pull a straight bar from shoulder height down to your thighs with mostly straight arms.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Attach a straight bar to a high cable pulley and face the machine.
2. Grab the bar with an overhand grip, step back slightly, and hinge forward a little at the hips.
3. Start with your arms straight in front of you at shoulder height and your torso braced.
4. Pull the bar down in a wide arc toward your thighs without bending your elbows.
5. Squeeze your lats at the bottom with the bar close to your hips.
6. Raise the bar back up slowly to shoulder height while keeping your arms long and your torso still.

Подсказки по технике: Arms long, elbows soft; Pull with your lats; Ribs down, core tight; Stop at your thighs

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows and turning it into a triceps pressdown; Leaning back and using body swing to move the bar; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Letting the bar drift away from the body at the bottom

Дыхание: Inhale as the bar rises to the start, and exhale as you pull it down toward your thighs.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
description:
An isolation cable exercise targeting the triceps by extending the arm downward against resistance.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand facing the cable stack with attachment at high position.
2. Grip the bar or rope with both hands.
3. Keep elbows tight to your body.
4. Push the attachment down until arms are fully extended.
5. Return slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lock elbows at sides; Control the movement; Don’t let elbows drift; Squeeze triceps at the bottom

Распространённые ошибки: Using too much weight; Letting elbows flare out; Leaning over the bar

Дыхание: Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return up.

name: Cable Twist (up-down)
description:
A standing cable rotation that trains the obliques by twisting the torso diagonally across the body.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the cable handle at about shoulder height and stand sideways to the machine with feet hip-width apart.
2. Grab the handle with both hands and extend your arms in front of your chest with a soft bend in your elbows.
3. Brace your core and rotate your torso away from the machine while guiding the handle diagonally down across your body.
4. Keep your hips mostly still and finish with your hands near the outside of your opposite hip.
5. Control the handle back to the start, then repeat all reps before switching sides or reverse the path to move from low to high.

Подсказки по технике: Rotate through your ribs; Keep hips quiet; Move on a diagonal; Brace before you twist

Распространённые ошибки: Turning the hips and feet with the cable; Bending and straightening the elbows to move the weight; Letting the cable yank the torso back; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears

Дыхание: Exhale as you rotate and pull the handle across your body; inhale as you return under control.

name: Calf Stretch with Rope
description:
A static stretch for the calf muscles using a rope or strap to pull the foot into dorsiflexion.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the floor with one leg extended.
2. Loop a rope or band around the ball of your foot.
3. Hold ends of rope and gently pull your foot toward you.
4. Keep knee straight for a deeper stretch.
5. Hold the stretch and then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knee extended; Pull gently; Don’t bounce; Relax into stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the knee; Jerking the rope; Holding breath

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and relax throughout the stretch.

name: Calf Stretch with Strap
description:
A seated stretch using a strap or resistance band to elongate the calf muscles.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with legs extended on the floor.
2. Loop a strap around the ball of one foot.
3. Hold strap ends and gently pull foot towards you.
4. Keep the knee straight and hold for desired time.
5. Switch sides and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knee straight; Flex foot toward you; Gentle pull, avoid jerking; Sit tall

Распространённые ошибки: Bending knee; Pulling too hard; Letting back round

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout stretch; exhale gently as you deepen the stretch.

name: Cambered Bar Lying Row
description:
A chest-supported barbell row performed lying face down on a bench to train the upper back with minimal body English.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Place a barbell on the floor under the end of a flat bench and lie face down so your chest is supported with your arms hanging straight down.
2. Plant your feet on the floor, brace your midsection, and grab the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
3. Lift the bar clear of the floor and let it hang directly below your shoulders with your neck neutral.
4. Pull the bar up toward the underside of the bench or lower chest by driving your elbows back.
5. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
6. Lower the bar under control until your arms are straight and the bar returns just above the floor.

Подсказки по технике: Chest stays on bench; Pull elbows back; Squeeze shoulder blades; Keep neck neutral

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the chest off the bench to move the bar; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Yanking the bar off the floor with momentum; Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar and exhale as you pull it up toward your chest.

name: Cardio Exercise
description:
Any aerobic physical activity aimed at increasing heart rate and cardiovascular health.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Select a cardio activity (running, jumping jacks, etc).
2. Warm up for 3-5 minutes.
3. Perform the chosen activity at a sustainable pace.
4. Maintain movement for set time or rounds.
5. Cool down and stretch afterwards.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Engage core; Use full range of motion; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Overexerting too soon; Neglecting form; Ignoring proper warm-up or cool-down

Дыхание: Breathe rhythmically; exhale on exertion, inhale during lower intensity.

name: Cardio Machine Exercise
description:
Any sustained aerobic activity using a cardio machine to increase heart rate and endurance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Choose your preferred cardio machine (treadmill, bike, etc).
2. Adjust resistance, incline, and settings as desired.
3. Begin with a brief warm-up.
4. Perform cardio at steady or variable intensity.
5. Cool down after session.

Подсказки по технике: Maintain upright posture; Relax shoulders; Use full range of motion; Control your breathing

Распространённые ошибки: Slouching or poor posture; Using excessive resistance or speed; Neglecting warm-up or cool-down

Дыхание: Breathe rhythmically according to intensity; exhale during exertion, inhale during recovery.

name: Cardio Machine Workouts
description:
Cardio exercises on machines like treadmills, bikes, ellipticals, or rowers improve cardiovascular fitness and endurance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Select a cardio machine suitable for your fitness level.
2. Adjust settings such as resistance, speed, and incline as desired.
3. Begin movement, focusing on steady pace and good posture.
4. Continue for your planned duration, monitoring intensity.
5. Cool down gradually and safely exit the machine.

Подсказки по технике: Maintain upright posture; Use full range of motion; Monitor intensity; Keep steady pace

Распространённые ошибки: Poor posture; Jumping on or off quickly; Overexerting too quickly

Дыхание: Breathe steadily throughout the workout.

name: Chest Dips
description:
A compound bodyweight exercise performed on parallel bars to target the chest, shoulders, and triceps.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grip parallel bars and lift to start.
2. Lean torso forward and bend elbows.
3. Lower until upper arms are parallel to floor.
4. Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch.
5. Push up through palms, returning to start.

Подсказки по технике: Lean forward; Keep elbows out to sides; Descend under control; Avoid locking elbows at top

Распространённые ошибки: Staying too upright (triceps focus); Going too deep; Flaring elbows excessively

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you press up.

name: Chest Lift with Rotation
description:
An abdominal exercise that combines a chest lift with torso rotation to target the obliques.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on floor.
2. Place hands behind head, elbows wide.
3. Engage core and lift head, neck, and shoulders off mat.
4. Rotate torso to one side while lifting.
5. Return to center and lower down; repeat on alternate side.

Подсказки по технике: Twist from core; Don't pull on neck; Elbows wide; Exhale on lift

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling on neck; Using arms to assist; Lifting too high; Not engaging core

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift and rotate, inhale as you lower.

name: Chin-to-Chest Stretch
description:
A gentle static stretch to release tension in the neck flexors by tilting the chin toward the chest.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit or stand with a straight back.
2. Gently lower your chin toward your chest.
3. Relax your shoulders and feel the stretch along your neck.
4. Hold the position for 15-30 seconds.
5. Slowly return to neutral.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly; Keep shoulders relaxed; Do not force the stretch; Hold gently

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing the stretch; Tensing shoulders; Overstretching the neck

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the stretch.

name: Chin-ups (narrow parallel grip)
description:
A bodyweight vertical pull using a narrow parallel grip to train the upper back, biceps, and forearms.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grab the parallel handles with a narrow neutral grip and hang with your arms straight.
2. Cross your ankles or keep your legs still, then brace your midline and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
3. Pull your elbows down and back to lift your chest toward your hands.
4. Keep pulling until your chin rises above your hands or handles.
5. Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight again.
6. Pause briefly at the bottom without relaxing your shoulders, then repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive elbows to ribs; Chest up to handles; Keep shoulders down; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears while pulling.; Swinging the legs or kipping to get upward.; Stopping short with the chin below the hands.; Dropping quickly to the bottom without control.

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom before you pull, exhale as you lift yourself up, and inhale again as you lower under control.

name: Close Feet Leg Press
description:
A leg press using a narrow foot placement to emphasize the quadriceps.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit in the leg press machine with feet close together on the platform.
2. Adjust seat and foot placement for comfort and safety.
3. Release safety handles and grip the handles for support.
4. Extend your knees to press the weight upward.
5. Lower platform slowly back to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knees aligned with toes; Do not lock out knees; Lower with control; Keep back and hips against pad
