Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees collapse inward; Allowing heels to lift; Shortening range of motion

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Close Grip Chin-Up
description:
A vertical pulling exercise emphasizing the lats and biceps using a supinated close grip.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width or slightly closer.
2. Hang at full arm extension, engage your core and back.
3. Pull your chest towards the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
4. Clear the bar with your chin, pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower yourself with control until arms are fully extended.

Подсказки по технике: Squeeze shoulder blades; Drive elbows down; Keep core tight; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Flaring elbows out; Partial range of motion

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
description:
A push-up variation with hands close together to emphasize triceps involvement.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Begin in a plank position with hands close together under your chest.
2. Keep your core tight and body in a straight line.
3. Lower your chest toward the hands, elbows tucked by your sides.
4. Pause briefly at the bottom without touching the floor.
5. Press up to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Tuck elbows; Keep hands under chest; Maintain straight body; Squeeze triceps at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Letting elbows flare; Sagging hips; Hands too wide

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you push up.

name: Commando Pull-Up
description:
A challenging pull-up variation using a parallel grip over the bar, emphasizing back, biceps, and grip strength.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with hands facing each other, one in front of the other.
2. Hang with your body turned so the bar is directly in front of your face.
3. Brace your core and pull up, bringing your head to one side of the bar.
4. Lower yourself under control back to the starting position.
5. Repeat, bringing your head to the opposite side on the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Keep body tight; Alternate sides; Control descent; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Losing control at bottom; Letting body swing; Not clearing chin to side; Uneven pull strength

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Crossover Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description:
A kneeling stretch targeting hip flexors with the trunk rotated across the body.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Start in a kneeling lunge with one knee on the ground and the opposite foot forward.
2. Tuck the pelvis under and shift your weight forward, feeling a stretch in the hip flexor of the rear leg.
3. Rotate your torso across the body, away from the back leg.
4. Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
5. Release and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep torso upright; Engage glutes; Rotate gently; Hips square

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the back; Letting front knee collapse inward; Leaning forward excessively

Дыхание: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you rotate and deepen stretch.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
description:
A chest pressing exercise performed on a 45-degree decline bench using dumbbells.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set a bench to a 45-degree decline angle.
2. Secure feet, lie back holding dumbbells over chest.
3. Lower dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
4. Pause at the bottom.
5. Press weights back to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Control lowering phase; Do not let elbows flare; Keep wrists straight; Press through the heels

Распространённые ошибки: Dropping elbows too low; Using uneven range; Arching lower back; Rushed reps

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, exhale as you press up.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
description:
A fly movement on a 45-degree decline bench to isolate the lower chest with dumbbells.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set bench to 45-degree decline, secure feet.
2. Lie back, arms extended above chest, slight bend in elbows.
3. Lower dumbbells in a wide arc to sides.
4. Pause at bottom for a stretch.
5. Return dumbbells to starting position, squeezing chest.

Подсказки по технике: Arms slightly bent; Big arc motion; Don't overstretch; Squeeze at top

Распространённые ошибки: Straightening arms; Dropping dumbbells too low; Using too much weight; Rushing the rep

Дыхание: Inhale as you open arms, exhale as you bring weights together.

name: Deep Push-Up
description:
A push-up performed with hands elevated for a greater range of motion to emphasize lower chest activation.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Place hands on elevated surfaces shoulder-width apart.
2. Assume a plank position with tight core and straight body.
3. Lower your chest between your hands, dipping below hand level.
4. Pause at the bottom, feeling a deep stretch in the chest.
5. Push up powerfully until arms are extended.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows at 45 degrees; Lower chest below hands; Maintain a straight line; Engage your core

Распространённые ошибки: Sagging hips; Flaring elbows; Not going deep enough; Letting shoulders round

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you push up.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
description:
A bent-over calf raise on a step that trains the calves through a full heel drop and strong lift.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or block and let your heels hang off.
2. Hinge forward at your hips and place your hands on a stable support for balance.
3. Keep your knees slightly bent and lower your heels until you feel a stretch in your calves.
4. Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while staying balanced.
6. Lower your heels back down with control and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lift heels straight up; Move through full range; Press through big toe; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing at the bottom instead of lowering under control; Rolling the ankles inward or outward; Using the hands to push the body up; Cutting the range short and not dropping the heels

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Shoulder Press
description:
A shoulder press using dumbbells, pressing one arm at a time to target the deltoids and stabilizers.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Hold dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
2. Brace your core and press one dumbbell overhead until arm is fully extended.
3. Lower to shoulder height as you press the opposite dumbbell overhead.
4. Continue alternating arms with each rep.
5. Maintain upright posture and avoid arching back.

Подсказки по технике: No arching; Core tight; Elbow under wrist; Smooth transition

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning to side; Pressing both at once; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale pressing up, inhale lowering down.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
description:
A seated dumbbell shoulder press that rotates from palms-in at the bottom to palms-forward overhead.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall on a bench with back support and plant your feet on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your shoulders with palms facing you and elbows bent.
3. Brace your midline and press the dumbbells upward while rotating your palms outward.
4. Finish overhead with arms straight and palms facing forward.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control while rotating your palms back toward you.
6. Return to the start with dumbbells in front of your shoulders and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Press and rotate smoothly; Keep ribs down; Wrists stacked over elbows; Finish biceps by ears

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the lower back as the dumbbells go overhead; Letting the elbows flare straight out at the bottom; Pressing the dumbbells up without rotating the hands; Lowering the dumbbells too fast and losing control

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you press and rotate overhead, then inhale as you lower back down.

name: Dumbbell Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
description:
A forearm isolation exercise curling a dumbbell behind the back to emphasize forearm flexors.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with dumbbell held behind your back, arm straight, palm facing backward.
2. Allow the dumbbell to roll down your fingers slightly.
3. Flex your wrist to curl the dumbbell up.
4. Squeeze at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the weight back down slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Wrist only; Don’t swing arm; Full wrist flexion; Controlled lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Using arm instead of wrist; Incomplete range; Jerking movement

Дыхание: Exhale during curl, inhale lowering down.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description:
A rowing movement that targets the back muscles while bracing the core in a bent-over position.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding dumbbells.
2. Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and chest up.
3. Let arms hang straight down, palms facing each other.
4. Pull dumbbells to your sides, elbows close to body.
5. Lower the weights under control to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Flat back; Lead with elbows; Engage core; Squeeze shoulder blades

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the back; Jerking the weights; Not fully extending arms; Using biceps too much

Дыхание: Exhale as you row up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description:
A standing arm exercise where you curl dumbbells from your sides to your shoulders to train the biceps.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, and palms facing forward.
2. Brace your torso and keep your elbows close to your ribs.
3. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without letting your upper arms swing forward.
4. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps.
5. Lower the dumbbells back down under control until your arms are straight.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows pinned to sides; Curl, don't swing; Squeeze at the top; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to start the curl; Letting the elbows drift forward as the weights rise; Using partial range and not lowering fully; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Press
description:
A pressing movement with dumbbells held close together to emphasize triceps activation.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Hold dumbbells together above chest, palms in.
3. Lower dumbbells toward sternum, elbows tight to torso.
4. Pause when elbows reach 90 degrees.
5. Press dumbbells back up by extending arms.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows close; Touch dumbbells together; Press through palms; Own the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring elbows out; Letting dumbbells drift apart; Arching back excessively; Lowering weights too far

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, exhale as you press up.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
description:
A seated single-arm biceps curl with the upper arm braced against the inner thigh to isolate the biceps.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat and knees apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
2. Lean forward slightly and brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your same-side thigh near the knee.
3. Let your arm hang straight down with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
4. Curl the dumbbell toward your same-side shoulder without moving your upper arm.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top when your forearm is nearly vertical.
6. Lower the dumbbell slowly until your elbow is fully extended, then repeat and switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbow glued to thigh; Curl only at the elbow; Palm stays facing up; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the elbow off the thigh during the curl; Swinging the torso to help raise the dumbbell; Cutting the rep short and not fully lowering; Bending the wrist back instead of keeping it neutral

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell and exhale as you curl it up.

name: Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl
description:
A dumbbell curl variation where each hand travels across the body to the opposite shoulder with a neutral grip.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing inward.
2. Brace your torso and keep your elbows pinned close to your ribs.
3. Curl one dumbbell diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder without swinging.
4. Pause briefly near shoulder height while keeping your wrist straight and palm facing inward.
5. Lower the dumbbell back to your side under control.
6. Repeat on the other arm, alternating sides.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay tucked; Curl across, not straight up; Keep wrists neutral; Don't swing the weight

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso or leaning back to lift the dumbbell; Letting the elbow drift forward away from the ribs; Twisting the wrist so the palm turns up at the top; Dropping the dumbbell quickly instead of lowering with control

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the dumbbell across your body, and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
description:
A hip-hinge lift with two dumbbells that trains the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back while lifting from standing to lockout.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Brace your midsection, pull your shoulders back, and keep your arms straight.
3. Push your hips back and bend your knees slightly as you slide the dumbbells down close to your legs.
4. Lower until the dumbbells reach around mid-shin or just below your knees while keeping your back flat.
5. Drive through your feet and push your hips forward to stand back up with the dumbbells at your thighs.
6. Finish tall with your hips and knees straight, then repeat the hinge.

Подсказки по технике: Hips back first; Keep dumbbells close; Chest proud; Stand tall at top

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as the dumbbells lower; Letting the dumbbells drift far in front of the legs; Squatting straight down instead of hinging the hips back; Locking the knees rigid or overbending them

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells with control, and exhale as you drive through your feet to stand up.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description:
A lying chest isolation exercise where you open the arms wide with dumbbells, then bring them together in an arc over the chest.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, and plant your feet on the floor.
2. Press the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other and soften your elbows slightly.
3. Lower both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until your elbows reach about chest level.
4. Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping the same elbow bend.
5. Squeeze your chest and bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc.

Подсказки по технике: Hug a wide barrel; Keep elbows softly bent; Lower with control; Squeeze chest at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press; Lowering the dumbbells too far below chest level; Bringing the dumbbells together by shrugging the shoulders forward; Dropping the arms quickly instead of controlling the arc

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells out to the sides, and exhale as you bring them back together over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Fly On Exercise Ball
description:
A chest isolation move done on an exercise ball, lowering dumbbells in a wide arc and bringing them back together over the chest.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the exercise ball holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
2. Walk your feet forward and roll down until your head, neck, and upper back rest on the ball, then lift your hips so your torso is level.
3. Press the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent.
4. Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc while keeping the same small bend in your elbows.
5. Stop when your upper arms are roughly in line with your torso and your chest feels stretched.
6. Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc and squeeze your chest at the top.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips up; Soft bend in elbows; Open wide, not too low; Bring bells together smoothly

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the hips sag below the torso; Turning the movement into a press by bending the elbows too much; Lowering the dumbbells far below chest level; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells out to the sides, and exhale as you bring them back together over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description:
A shoulder isolation exercise where you lift dumbbells straight forward from your thighs to shoulder height.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs, palms facing your legs.
2. Brace your torso and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
3. Raise both dumbbells straight in front of you until your hands reach about shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly without shrugging your shoulders.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to your thighs with control.
6. Repeat from a still, upright stance.

Подсказки по технике: Lift to shoulder height; Keep ribs down; Lead with your hands; Don't shrug up

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells up with the hips or torso.; Lifting the weights higher than shoulder level.; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.; Bending the elbows more as the weights rise.

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
description:
A front-loaded squat holding one dumbbell at the chest to train the quads, glutes, and legs through a controlled deep squat.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest with both hands.
2. Brace your midsection and keep your elbows pointed down close to your body.
3. Sit your hips down and back while bending your knees, and lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly lower.
4. Keep the dumbbell tight to your chest and your feet flat as your knees track over your toes.
5. Drive through your whole foot to stand back up until your hips and knees are fully extended.
6. Reset your stance and repeat the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Keep heels down; Knees track over toes; Hold the bell close

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the dumbbell drift away from the chest; Heels lifting off the floor at the bottom; Knees collapsing inward during the squat; Folding the chest forward instead of staying upright

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower into the squat, and exhale as you stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Grip Incline Bench Row
originalName: Dumbbell Hammer Grip Incline Bench Row
description:
A back-focused row performed chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells and a neutral (hammer) grip.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees and lie facedown with dumbbells.
2. Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral/hammer grip).
3. Pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
4. Pause and contract your back muscles at the top.
5. Lower the weights slowly with control.

Подсказки по технике: Chest on bench; Elbows tight; No shrugging; Full squeeze

Распространённые ошибки: Letting chest leave bench; Over-rowing with biceps; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
description:
A pressing exercise on an incline bench using dumbbells to train the upper chest, shoulders, and triceps.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs.
2. Lie back on the bench and bring the dumbbells to chest level with your palms facing forward.
3. Plant your feet on the floor and position your elbows slightly below shoulder height.
4. Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest until your arms are straight.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control to the sides of your upper chest.
6. Repeat by pressing back up along the same path.

Подсказки по технике: Keep wrists stacked; Drive feet into floor; Lower with control; Press over upper chest

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Letting the dumbbells drift toward the face; Bouncing the dumbbells off the chest position; Arching the lower back off the bench

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you press them up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl
description:
An arm isolating curl performed seated on an incline bench to maximize stretch and activation of the biceps.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the bench to a 45-60 degree incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang fully extended at your sides, elbows near your body.
3. Curl the dumbbells up by flexing your elbows, keeping upper arms stationary.
4. Pause and squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the weights under control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows still; Let arms fully extend; Do not swing weights; Squeeze at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging arms for momentum; Elbows drifting forward; Partial range of motion

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
description:
A seated biceps curl on an incline bench that trains the biceps through a long range with dumbbells.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang straight down under your shoulders with your palms facing forward.
3. Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
4. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps.
5. Lower the dumbbells slowly until your elbows are fully straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows still; Palms stay forward; Lift with the biceps; Lower under control

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells to start the curl; Letting the elbows drift forward as the weights rise; Stopping short instead of fully lowering the dumbbells; Bending the wrists back while curling

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you curl them up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
description:
A chest isolation exercise done on an incline bench by opening the arms wide with dumbbells and squeezing them back together.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and sit with a dumbbell in each hand on your thighs.
2. Lie back and press the dumbbells above your upper chest with your palms facing each other.
3. Bend your elbows slightly and keep that bend locked in.
4. Lower the dumbbells out to your sides in a wide arc until they reach chest level or a gentle chest stretch.
5. Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together over your upper chest along the same arc.
6. Stop with the dumbbells nearly touching and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Soft elbows, fixed angle; Open wide, not too low; Squeeze chest at the top; Keep shoulders down

Распространённые ошибки: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press; Lowering the dumbbells far below chest level; Letting the dumbbells drift behind the shoulders; Clanging the dumbbells together at the top

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells out to the sides, and exhale as you bring them back together over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly On Exercise Ball
originalName: Dumbbell Incline Fly On Exercise Ball
description:
A chest isolation exercise done with dumbbells while supported on an exercise ball at an incline angle.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and position your upper back on the exercise ball so your torso is angled upward.
2. Plant your feet firmly on the floor and raise the dumbbells above your upper chest with your palms facing each other.
3. Keep a soft bend in your elbows and lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
4. Stop when your elbows are roughly level with your chest and you feel your chest stretch.
5. Squeeze your chest and bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc until they meet above your chest.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows slightly bent; Open wide under control; Lift through your chest; Feet planted, hips steady

Распространённые ошибки: Straightening the elbows and turning the move into a press; Lowering the dumbbells too far below chest level; Bouncing the hips or letting the ball roll around; Bringing the dumbbells up unevenly or clanking them together

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells out to the sides, and exhale as you bring them back together above your chest.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
description:
A seated incline curl with a neutral grip that targets the biceps and forearms while limiting body swing.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Let your arms hang straight down by your sides with your palms facing each other.
3. Keep your upper arms still and curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
4. Stop when your forearms are nearly vertical and squeeze your biceps.
5. Lower the dumbbells slowly until your elbows are fully straight again.
6. Repeat without swinging your torso or letting your shoulders roll forward.

Подсказки по технике: Palms face each other; Keep elbows pinned; Lift, don't swing; Lower under control

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells up with the torso; Letting the elbows drift forward during the curl; Turning the palms up at the top; Cutting the lowering phase short

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press
description:
An incline dumbbell press with a neutral grip that trains the upper chest, shoulders, and triceps.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench and sit with a dumbbell in each hand on your thighs.
2. Lie back on the bench and bring the dumbbells to chest height with your palms facing each other.
3. Plant your feet, pull your shoulder blades back into the bench, and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
4. Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are straight above your upper chest.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control until they return to chest level with your palms still facing in.
6. Repeat the press without bouncing the dumbbells off your chest or shoulders.

Подсказки по технике: Drive up over upper chest; Keep palms facing in; Pin shoulders to bench; Wrists stacked over elbows

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Letting the dumbbells drift back over the face; Banging the dumbbells together at the top; Arching the lower back and lifting the hips

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells to chest level, and exhale as you press them up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Rear Lateral Raise
description:
A chest-supported dumbbell raise that targets the rear delts by lifting the arms out to the sides on an incline bench.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Lie face down with your chest supported on the bench and let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
3. Turn your palms to face each other and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
4. Raise both arms out and slightly back until they reach shoulder height.
5. Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the top.
6. Lower the dumbbells with control back to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Chest stays on the pad; Lift to shoulder height; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells up with momentum; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Straightening the elbows into a wide row; Lifting the arms far past shoulder height

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you raise them out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Incline Row
description:
A chest-supported dumbbell row on an incline bench that targets the upper back while limiting body momentum.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench to a moderate angle and lie face down with your chest supported and feet planted on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down and palms facing each other.
3. Brace your midline and pull your shoulders down and back.
4. Row the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs by bending your elbows and driving them back.
5. Squeeze your upper back at the top without lifting your chest off the bench.
6. Lower the dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended again.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Keep chest on the pad; Squeeze shoulder blades together; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Yanking the dumbbells with body momentum; Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Lifting the chest off the bench at the top

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you row them up toward your ribs.

name: Dumbbell Incline Shrug
description:
A chest-supported shrug on an incline bench using dumbbells to target the upper traps with minimal body momentum.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and sit with your chest supported against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and let your arms hang straight down at your sides with your palms facing in.
3. Plant your feet firmly on the floor and keep your chest against the bench.
4. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows.
5. Pause briefly at the top, then lower your shoulders back down under control.
6. Repeat from a dead hang each rep.

Подсказки по технике: Arms stay long; Shrug straight up; Keep chest on pad; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows and turning the rep into a row; Rolling the shoulders forward or backward at the top; Lifting the chest off the bench to move the weight; Using momentum and dropping quickly between reps

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you shrug your shoulders up, then inhale as you lower back down.

name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Extension
description:
A seated incline dumbbell triceps exercise where you bend and straighten the elbows to move the weights behind and above the head.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit back on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Press the dumbbells overhead with your palms facing each other.
3. Keep your elbows pointed up and close to your head.
4. Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending only your elbows.
5. Pause briefly when your forearms are below parallel to the floor.
6. Straighten your elbows to raise the dumbbells back overhead.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay tucked; Upper arms stay still; Lower with control; Finish straight overhead

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare wide out to the sides.; Upper arms drift backward and turn it into a press.; Lowering only a few inches behind the head.; Arching the low back off the bench.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells behind your head, and exhale as you extend your elbows to bring them overhead.

name: Dumbbell Iron Cross
description:
A shoulder isolation exercise where you raise dumbbells out to the sides to train the delts.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Hold a slight bend in your elbows and turn your palms toward your sides.
3. Raise both arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly with your shoulders level and your wrists in line with your elbows.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to your sides with control.
6. Repeat without swinging your torso or bouncing the weights.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Lift to shoulder height; Keep shoulders down; Move with control

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to start each rep; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Lifting the dumbbells higher than shoulder level; Straightening the elbows completely and locking the arms

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you raise them out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Kickback
description:
A bent-over triceps isolation exercise where you extend dumbbells behind you while keeping the upper arms still.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and pin your upper arms alongside your torso.
3. Brace your torso and keep your elbows still.
4. Straighten your arms by driving the dumbbells back until your elbows are fully extended.
5. Squeeze your triceps at the back of the movement.
6. Bend your elbows under control to return to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows glued in; Only move the forearms; Squeeze at full extension; Keep your back flat

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells with the shoulders or torso; Letting the elbows drift away from the ribs; Dropping the upper arms during the set; Snapping the weights down instead of lowering slowly

Дыхание: Inhale as you bend the elbows to the start position, and exhale as you straighten the arms back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description:
A shoulder isolation exercise where you lift dumbbells out to the sides to target the lateral delts.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
2. Set your shoulders down and brace your midsection.
3. Raise both arms out to the sides until your hands reach about shoulder height, keeping a soft bend in your elbows.
4. Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to your sides with control.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Stop at shoulder height; Keep shoulders down; Soft bend in elbows

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Swinging the torso to heave the dumbbells upward; Lifting the hands well above shoulder height; Straightening the elbows and turning it into a front swing

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells to the sides, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
description:
A lower-body exercise where you hold dumbbells and step into alternating lunges to train the glutes, quads, and legs.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet hip-width apart.
2. Step one foot forward far enough that both knees can bend comfortably.
3. Lower your body until your front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor and your back knee drops toward the floor.
4. Keep your torso upright and your front foot flat as you pause briefly at the bottom.
5. Push through your front heel to return to standing.
6. Repeat on the other side, alternating legs each rep.

Подсказки по технике: Chest tall; Front heel stays down; Knees track over toes; Drop straight down

Распространённые ошибки: Taking too short a step so the front knee shoots far past the toes.; Leaning the torso forward as you lower into the lunge.; Letting the front heel lift off the floor.; Pushing off the back foot instead of driving through the front leg.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower into the lunge, and exhale as you push back to standing.

name: Dumbbell Lying Alternate Extension
description:
A lying triceps isolation exercise where you lower one dumbbell at a time toward your forehead and extend the elbow back to the top.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, and press both arms straight up over your chest with palms facing each other.
2. Keep one arm still above your chest as you bend the other elbow and lower that dumbbell beside your forehead.
3. Stop when your forearm points down and your upper arm stays mostly vertical.
4. Straighten the bent arm to bring the dumbbell back above your chest.
5. Repeat on the other side while keeping the first arm locked out.
6. Continue alternating sides with both shoulders and head resting on the bench.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows point to the ceiling; Only move at the elbow; Keep one arm locked out; Lower beside your forehead

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare wide as the dumbbell lowers; Upper arms drift backward instead of staying upright; The non-working arm drops or bends; Turning it into a press from the chest

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower each dumbbell and exhale as you straighten the elbow to bring it back up.

name: Dumbbell Lying Hammer Press
description:
A flat bench dumbbell press done with a neutral grip to train the chest, triceps, and shoulders.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, and press the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other.
2. Plant your feet on the floor and brace your torso while keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows.
3. Lower the dumbbells under control to either side of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked from your shoulders.
4. Pause briefly when your upper arms reach bench level or the dumbbells lightly touch your chest line.
5. Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended above your chest, keeping the palms facing each other throughout.
6. Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep palms facing in; Tuck elbows slightly; Press over mid-chest; Keep wrists straight

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare straight out to the sides.; Dumbbells drift toward the face instead of staying over the chest.; Wrists bend back under the dumbbells.; Lowering too fast and bouncing at the bottom.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells to your chest and exhale as you press them back up.

name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
description:
A hamstring isolation exercise where a dumbbell is held between the feet during leg curls.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face down on a bench, legs straight, dumbbell held between your feet.
2. Hold onto the bench for stability.
3. Contract your hamstrings to curl the dumbbell upward toward your glutes.
4. Pause at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the dumbbell in a controlled motion to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips down; Squeeze at top; Control the descent; Engage hamstrings

Распространённые ошибки: Allowing hips to lift; Letting dumbbell slip; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Delt Row
description:
A chest-supported dumbbell row variation that targets the rear delts and upper back by pulling the elbows out wide.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, with your chest supported and arms hanging straight down.
2. Set your feet firmly on the floor and turn your palms to face each other.
3. Pull your elbows out to the sides and row the dumbbells up toward your upper chest.
4. Squeeze your upper back at the top while keeping your chest on the bench.
5. Lower the dumbbells back down under control until your arms are straight again.
6. Repeat without swinging the weights or shrugging your shoulders.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Chest stays on the bench; Pull wide, not low; Squeeze shoulder blades together

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling the elbows close to the ribs like a regular row; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Lifting the chest off the bench to move the weights; Swinging the dumbbells instead of lowering them with control

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you row them up toward your upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
description:
A lying dumbbell triceps exercise where you bend and straighten the elbows to lower the weights toward the forehead and press them back up.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, and press the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other.
2. Pull your shoulders down into the bench and straighten your wrists so the dumbbells stay stacked over your elbows.
3. Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your forehead while keeping your upper arms mostly still.
4. Stop when your elbows are fully bent and the dumbbells are close to your head.
5. Straighten your elbows to drive the dumbbells back to the start position above your chest.
6. Repeat each rep without letting your elbows flare wide.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows tucked; Upper arms stay still; Bend only at elbows; Stack wrists over elbows

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare out wide as the dumbbells lower.; Upper arms drift backward or forward during the rep.; Dumbbells drop too low behind the head instead of beside the forehead.; Wrists bend back instead of staying straight.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells toward your forehead, and exhale as you extend your elbows to raise them back up.

name: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise
description:
A single-arm shoulder isolation exercise where you raise a dumbbell out to the side to train the lateral delts.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at one side with a slight bend in your elbow.
2. Brace your core and keep your shoulders level as your free arm stays relaxed by your side or on your hip.
3. Lift the dumbbell out to the side until your hand reaches about shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder toward your ear.
5. Lower the dumbbell back to your side with control.
6. Complete all reps on one arm, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbow; Stop at shoulder height; Keep shoulders level; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the working shoulder up toward the ear; Swinging the torso or leaning to start the lift; Raising the dumbbell higher than shoulder height; Locking the elbow completely straight

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell, and exhale as you lift it out to the side.

name: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
originalName: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
description:
A single-arm preacher curl variation that adds a wrist rotation to train the biceps and forearms through both the lift and lowering phase.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit at a preacher bench and plant your feet on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place the back of your upper arm flat against the pad with your arm nearly straight.
3. Start with your palm facing up and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without lifting your upper arm off the pad.
4. Pause near the top and rotate your wrist until your palm faces down.
5. Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is nearly straight while keeping your palm facing down.
6. Rotate your wrist back to palm-up at the bottom and repeat before switching arms.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arm glued to pad; Curl, then rotate; Lower slowly on the way down; Keep wrist movement controlled

Распространённые ошибки: Upper arm lifting off the preacher pad; Swinging the dumbbell instead of curling it; Dropping the weight quickly on the lowering phase; Rotating the wrist too early before reaching the top

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the dumbbell up, then inhale as you rotate and lower it back down.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
description:
An isolation exercise for the triceps performed one arm at a time, with a dumbbell overhead.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Hold dumbbell in one hand, arm extended overhead.
2. Support upper arm with free hand if needed.
3. Lower dumbbell behind head by bending the elbow.
4. Pause when forearm is parallel to ground.
5. Extend arm fully to return to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep upper arm vertical; Only move forearm; No swinging; Full elbow extension

Распространённые ошибки: Moving upper arm; Dropping weight too far; Allowing elbow to flare; Rushing movement

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell, exhale as you press up.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Wrist Curl
description:
A seated forearm isolation exercise where the wrists curl dumbbells upward with the forearms supported on a bench.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit at a bench and place your forearms on top with your palms facing up.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and slide forward until your wrists hang just past the bench edge.
3. Let your hands lower to gently stretch your wrists at the bottom.
4. Curl your wrists up by lifting your knuckles toward your forearms.
5. Squeeze your forearms briefly at the top.
6. Lower the dumbbells back down under control until your wrists extend again.

Подсказки по технике: Move only your wrists; Forearms stay glued down; Curl through full range; Lower slowly

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the forearms off the bench during the curl.; Swinging the dumbbells instead of moving only the wrists.; Using partial range and stopping before the wrists fully lower.; Bending the elbows to help raise the weight.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your wrists and exhale as you curl them up.

name: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent Over Row
originalName: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent Over Row
description:
A bent-over dumbbell row where you rotate your palms during the pull to train the upper back, biceps, and forearms.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight and palms facing each other.
2. Hinge at your hips until your torso is leaned forward, soften your knees, and keep your back flat.
3. Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders and brace your core.
4. Row both dumbbells toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back.
5. Rotate your palms as you lift until they face more backward or away from your body at the top.
6. Pause and squeeze your upper back, then lower the dumbbells with control as you rotate your palms back to neutral.

Подсказки по технике: Keep your back flat; Drive elbows back; Rotate through the pull; Squeeze shoulder blades together

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as you hinge forward; Standing up taller to swing the dumbbells; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Letting the wrists curl instead of rotating the forearms

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you row and rotate the dumbbells up, then inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Over Exercise Ball
originalName: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Over Exercise Ball
description:
A single-arm biceps curl done with the upper arm braced against an exercise ball to limit cheating and isolate the elbow flexors.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall on the exercise ball with both feet flat and spread for balance.
2. Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and brace the back of your upper arm against the ball.
3. Let the arm straighten almost fully so the dumbbell hangs below your elbow.
4. Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without lifting your elbow off the ball.
5. Squeeze your biceps at the top while keeping your wrist straight.
6. Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is almost straight, then repeat and switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbow glued down; Curl only at the elbow; Keep wrist straight; Lower under control

Распространённые ошибки: Elbow slides or lifts off the ball during the curl.; Shoulder rolls forward to help raise the dumbbell.; Wrist bends back or curls inward at the top.; Body rocks on the ball to create momentum.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell and exhale as you curl it up.

name: Dumbbell Pronate-grip Triceps Extension
description:
A seated overhead triceps exercise using one dumbbell held with both hands to bend and straighten the elbows.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall on a bench or chair with both feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold one dumbbell with both hands by the handle using an overhand grip and press it straight overhead.
3. Bring your upper arms close to your ears and point your elbows forward.
4. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending only your elbows.
5. Stop when your forearms are below parallel and your upper arms stay mostly still.
6. Straighten your elbows to raise the dumbbell back to the overhead start position.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay close in; Upper arms stay still; Brace your ribs down; Lock out overhead

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare wide out to the sides.; Upper arms drift backward and move during the rep.; Lower back arches as the weight goes overhead.; The dumbbell drops too low and bumps the upper back.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell behind your head, and exhale as you straighten your elbows to lift it overhead.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
description:
A chest-supported biceps curl on an incline bench that limits body swing and keeps tension on the arms.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest supported.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down and palms facing forward.
3. Keep your upper arms still and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
4. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps.
5. Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest on bench; Elbows stay still; Curl through full range; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the chest off the bench to swing the weights; Letting the elbows drift forward during the curl; Cutting the rep short and not fully lowering the dumbbells; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells and exhale as you curl them up.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
description:
A bent-over dumbbell row variation that targets the rear delts by pulling the elbows out wide to the sides.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Hinge at your hips until your torso is leaned forward, soften your knees, and let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
3. Brace your core and keep your back flat as you pull your elbows up and out to the sides.
4. Lift until your upper arms are roughly in line with your shoulders and squeeze your upper back.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control to the start position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows.; Keep your back flat.; Raise arms out, not back.; Squeeze shoulder blades together.

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as you hinge forward.; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.; Pulling the dumbbells straight back close to the ribs.; Swinging the torso to start each rep.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you row them up and out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
description:
A seated calf exercise using a dumbbell on the thighs to train ankle plantarflexion through a full range of motion.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench or chair with your knees bent and place the balls of your feet on a small raised surface with your heels hanging off.
2. Set a dumbbell across the tops of your thighs just above your knees and hold it steady with both hands.
3. Let your heels drop down until you feel a stretch through your calves.
4. Press through the balls of your feet and raise your heels as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping the dumbbell steady.
6. Lower your heels back down under control and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through big toe; Lift heels straight up; Use full ankle range; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing the heels at the bottom instead of lowering under control.; Rolling the ankles inward or outward as the heels rise.; Placing the dumbbell too close to the knees so it slides during the set.; Using a very short range of motion and not dropping the heels below the step.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise
description:
A seated shoulder isolation exercise where you lift dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height to train the front delts.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing down or slightly toward each other, and brace your midsection.
3. Raise both arms straight forward until the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top without leaning back or shrugging your shoulders.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control back to the starting position by your thighs.
6. Repeat each rep with the same seated posture and arm path.

Подсказки по технике: Lift to shoulder height; Keep torso still; Soft bend in elbows; Shoulders down and back

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning the torso back to swing the dumbbells up; Raising the dumbbells above shoulder height; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Dropping the weights quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
description:
A seated triceps isolation exercise where you hinge forward and extend dumbbells back by straightening the elbows.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Hinge forward from your hips and keep your back flat with your chest angled toward your thighs.
3. Pull your elbows up beside your torso and bend them to about 90 degrees.
4. Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows to kick the dumbbells back behind you.
5. Squeeze your triceps with your arms fully extended.
6. Bend your elbows slowly to return the dumbbells to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows glued in; Only move the forearms; Back flat, chest up; Squeeze at full extension

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the dumbbells with the shoulders; Letting the elbows drift away from the torso; Dropping the upper arms during the rep; Rounding the back while leaning forward

Дыхание: Inhale as you bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you straighten your arms back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise
description:
A seated shoulder isolation exercise where you raise dumbbells out to the sides to target the delts.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit upright on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Set your shoulders down and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
3. Raise both arms out to your sides until the dumbbells reach about shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to your sides with control and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Keep shoulders down; Lift to shoulder height; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to start the lift; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Lifting the dumbbells higher than shoulder level; Straightening the elbows into a stiff arm

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells out to the sides, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
description:
A seated forearm isolation exercise where you curl dumbbells by bending at the wrists with a neutral grip.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
2. Rest your forearms on your thighs near your knees and let your wrists hang just past your knees.
3. Start with your wrists straight and your hands hanging down under control.
4. Curl the dumbbells upward by bending only at your wrists while keeping your forearms pressed into your thighs.
5. Squeeze briefly at the top without turning your palms up or down.
6. Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the start until your wrists are fully extended.

Подсказки по технике: Move only your wrists; Keep palms facing in; Forearms stay glued down; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the forearms off the thighs to swing the dumbbells up; Turning the palms up or down during the curl; Bouncing the dumbbells at the bottom; Using the shoulders or elbows to help the movement

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl your wrists up, and inhale as you lower the dumbbells back down.

name: Dumbbell Seated Preacher Curl
description:
A seated single-arm biceps curl done against a preacher pad to isolate the elbow flexors and limit body momentum.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the preacher bench and plant your feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up and place the back of your upper arm firmly against the pad.
3. Start with your arm nearly straight and let the dumbbell hang just above the bottom of the pad.
4. Curl the dumbbell upward by bending your elbow while keeping your upper arm pressed into the pad.
5. Lift until the dumbbell nears your shoulder and briefly squeeze your biceps.
6. Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is nearly straight again, then repeat before switching sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep upper arm glued down; Curl only at the elbow; Lower with control; Squeeze at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Upper arm lifting off the pad during the curl; Swinging the dumbbell instead of moving smoothly; Stopping short and not lowering near full extension; Bending the wrist back as the dumbbell rises

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the dumbbell up, and inhale as you lower it back down under control.

name: Dumbbell Seated Triceps Extension
description:
A seated overhead dumbbell triceps exercise where you lower the weight behind your head and extend your elbows to press it back up.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall on a bench with both feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold one dumbbell by the top end with both hands and press it straight overhead.
3. Keep your upper arms close to your head and brace your torso.
4. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head under control.
5. Stop when your forearms are below parallel and your elbows stay pointed up.
6. Straighten your elbows to raise the dumbbell back to the overhead start position.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows point up; Keep biceps by ears; Move only at elbows; Brace your ribs down

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare wide out to the sides.; Lower back arches as the weight goes overhead.; Upper arms drift backward and forward during the rep.; The dumbbell drops too low with no control behind the head.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell behind your head, and exhale as you extend your elbows to raise it overhead.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description:
An isolation exercise where you hold dumbbells at your sides and lift your shoulders up to train the trapezius muscles.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Let your arms hang straight with your palms facing your body.
3. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows.
4. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso still.
5. Lower your shoulders back down under control to the start position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Shoulders straight up; Arms stay long; Neck relaxed; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Rolling the shoulders in circles instead of lifting straight up and down.; Bending the elbows and turning the move into an upright row.; Leaning the torso back or forward to swing the dumbbells.; Jutting the head forward as the shoulders rise.

Дыхание: Exhale as you shrug your shoulders up, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
description:
A standing oblique exercise where you hold one dumbbell and bend your torso sideways under control.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
2. Place your other hand on your hip or behind your head and brace your stomach.
3. Keep your chest up and slowly bend your torso sideways away from the dumbbell.
4. Lower the dumbbell down the side of your leg as far as you can without twisting or leaning forward.
5. Squeeze your obliques and return to standing tall.
6. Complete all reps on one side, then switch hands and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Bend only to the side; Keep chest tall; Brace your core; Move slowly and controlled

Распространённые ошибки: Twisting the torso as you bend; Leaning forward instead of sideways; Shrugging the weighted shoulder up; Using momentum to swing back up

Дыхание: Inhale as you bend sideways, then exhale as you return to standing.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
description:
A single-leg calf exercise using a dumbbell and step to strengthen the calves through a full ankle range of motion.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand on the edge of a step with one foot, placing the ball of your foot on the step and letting your heel hang off.
2. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and lightly brace your other hand on a wall or rail.
3. Lift your nonworking foot off the step and straighten your standing leg.
4. Press through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your ankle stacked over your toes.
6. Lower your heel slowly below the step until you feel a stretch in your calf.
7. Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Push through your big toe; Rise straight up; Lower with control; Keep hips level

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control; Rolling the ankle inward or outward during the raise; Bending the standing knee to help drive up; Using the support hand to pull the body upward

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heel, and exhale as you press up onto your toes.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
description:
A one-leg squat holding dumbbells that challenges the glutes, quads, balance, and lower-body control.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other leg straight in front of you.
3. Brace your torso and bend your standing knee and hip to lower under control.
4. Keep the lifted leg off the floor and lower as far as you can while staying balanced.
5. Drive through the standing foot to rise back to the starting position.
6. Complete all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Sit back; Keep knee tracking forward; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the lifted foot touch the floor between reps; Rounding the back at the bottom; Standing knee collapsing inward; Dropping too fast and losing balance

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, and exhale as you drive back up to standing.

name: Dumbbell Squat
description:
A squat holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides to train the glutes, quads, and legs.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and place your feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Brace your core, keep your chest up, and let your arms hang straight.
3. Bend your hips and knees together to sit down and slightly back.
4. Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor or as low as you can while keeping your heels down.
5. Drive through your midfoot and heels to stand back up.
6. Finish tall with your hips and knees fully straight before the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Knees track over toes; Keep heels down; Stand tall at top

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the knees cave inward on the way down or up.; Rising onto the toes and lifting the heels off the floor.; Rounding the upper or lower back at the bottom.; Dropping the chest forward so the dumbbells swing ahead of the legs.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower into the squat, then exhale as you stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
description:
A standing calf exercise where you hold dumbbells at your sides and raise your heels to train the calves and ankles.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand and place your feet about hip-width apart.
2. Let your arms hang by your sides and keep your knees softly bent.
3. Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as you can.
4. Pause briefly at the top while staying tall through your torso.
5. Lower your heels back to the floor with control and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Rise straight up; Press through big toe; Control the lowering; Keep torso tall

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing at the bottom instead of lowering under control; Rolling the ankles outward or inward; Bending the knees to turn it into a squat; Leaning the torso forward as the heels lift

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto your toes.

name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift
description:
A hip-hinge deadlift with dumbbells that emphasizes the hamstrings and glutes while keeping only a slight knee bend.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Soften your knees slightly and brace your midsection.
3. Push your hips straight back and slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs.
4. Lower until the dumbbells reach mid-shin or you feel a strong hamstring stretch while keeping your back flat.
5. Drive your feet into the floor and extend your hips to stand back up.
6. Finish tall with the dumbbells at your thighs and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Hips back, not down; Keep dumbbells close; Back flat the whole time; Feel the hamstring stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the knees too much and turning it into a squat; Letting the dumbbells drift away from the legs; Rounding the lower back on the way down; Looking up and cranking the neck

Дыхание: Inhale as you hinge and lower the dumbbells, then exhale as you drive your hips forward to stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
description:
A lower body exercise using a dumbbell in a sumo stance to target the glutes, quads, and adductors.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet wide apart, toes angled outward.
2. Grip the dumbbell vertically between your legs.
3. Keep chest up and core braced.
4. Squat down, pushing knees outward.
5. Drive through heels to stand up.

Подсказки по технике: Knees out; Keep chest tall; Sit hips back; Drive through heels

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees cave in; Rounding the back; Shallow squats

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you stand up.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
description:
A standing shoulder and upper-trap exercise where you pull dumbbells up the front of your body with elbows leading.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
2. Brace your midsection and keep your chest lifted.
3. Pull the dumbbells straight up along the front of your body by driving your elbows up and out.
4. Raise until the dumbbells reach about upper-chest height and your elbows stay higher than your hands.
5. Pause briefly, then lower the dumbbells back to your thighs with control.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Keep dumbbells close; Shoulders down and back; Lift to upper chest

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling the dumbbells all the way to the chin; Letting the wrists bend sharply at the top; Swinging the torso to start the lift; Hands rising higher than the elbows

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the dumbbells up, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
description:
A rhythmic arm movement to increase chest mobility and warm up the pectoral muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
3. Swing your arms forward, crossing them in front of your chest.
4. Open your arms wide, stretching your chest as you do.
5. Repeat the swinging motion for the desired number of repetitions.

Подсказки по технике: Keep movements controlled; Maintain upright posture; Engage core; Avoid twisting torso

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging arms too forcefully; Allowing shoulders to shrug; Rotating the torso excessively

Дыхание: Breathe naturally throughout the movement.

name: Elliptical Trainer
description:
A low-impact cardio exercise using a standing elliptical machine for total body endurance and aerobic gains.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
2. Select desired resistance and incline.
3. Begin moving feet in a smooth, elliptical pattern.
4. Push and pull the handles with your arms in sync with your strides.
5. Maintain a steady cadence and upright posture.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Balance weight evenly; Smooth, controlled motion; Engage core lightly

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning too far forward or backward; Relying only on legs or arms; Choppy, fast movements

Дыхание: Maintain rhythmic, deep breathing throughout the workout.

name: Exercise Ball Sit-Up
description:
A core exercise where sit-ups are performed while stabilizing on a Swiss ball, increasing abdominal activation.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the exercise ball with feet flat on the floor.
2. Walk feet forward, rolling until the ball supports your lower back.
3. Cross arms over your chest or position hands behind your head.
4. Engage your core and sit up, lifting your upper body.
5. Lower back down under control to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep feet planted; Avoid pulling neck; Engage abs throughout; Do not arch lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Feet lifting off the ground; Ball not positioned under lower back

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Exercise Ball Spinal Stretch
description:
A gentle back extension and stretch performed by draping the body over an exercise ball to mobilize the spine.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the exercise ball with feet hip-width apart.
2. Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling until your back is draped over the ball.
3. Let your arms extend overhead or rest beside you for support.
4. Relax into the stretch, allowing your spine to gently extend.
5. Hold for the desired duration, then carefully return to a seated position.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly and controlled; Keep feet planted; Relax neck and shoulders; Breathe deeply

Распространённые ошибки: Arching excessively; Letting hips sag too low; Losing balance on the ball

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
description:
Classic biceps curl using an EZ barbell to build arm mass with ergonomic grip.

Оборудование: EZ-гриф

Техника выполнения:
1. Grip the EZ bar at angled sections, palms facing up.
2. Stand tall with arms fully extended and elbows anchored.
3. Curl the bar upward, contracting the biceps.
4. Pause and squeeze at the top.
5. Lower the bar down slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows stationary; Use full range of motion; Don't swing the bar; Control tempo

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Letting elbows move forward; Partial reps

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale lowering the bar.

name: EZ Bar Lying Triceps Extension
description:
Lying triceps extension using EZ bar to target triceps with reduced wrist strain.

Оборудование: EZ-гриф

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on bench, grip EZ bar with medium width.
2. Extend arms fully above chest.
3. Bend elbows, lowering bar toward forehead.
4. Keep upper arms stationary.
5. Extend to starting position, repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lock upper arms; Lower with control; Don't move elbows; Full triceps extension

Распространённые ошибки: Flaring elbows; Moving upper arms; Lowering bar too far past head

Дыхание: Inhale lowering bar, exhale extending arms.

name: EZ Barbell Anti Gravity Press
description:
A standing overhead press using an EZ bar to train the delts, triceps, and upper chest through a full pressing range.

Оборудование: EZ-гриф

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip- to shoulder-width apart and hold the EZ bar at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
2. Brace your core and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
3. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended above your shoulders.
4. Move your head slightly back as the bar passes your face, then bring your head through under the bar at the top.
5. Lower the bar under control back to shoulder height.
6. Repeat each rep from a stable standing position.

Подсказки по технике: Press straight overhead; Ribs down, core tight; Wrists stacked over elbows; Head through at top

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning back hard and turning it into an incline press; Pressing the bar out in front instead of overhead; Flaring the elbows too far out from the start; Lowering the bar too fast and bouncing at the shoulders

Дыхание: Inhale and brace at shoulder height, exhale as you press overhead, and inhale again as you lower the bar back down.

name: Feet and Ankles Rotation Stretch
description:
A mobility exercise involving circular ankle movements that target the calves and improve ankle flexibility.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit or stand and lift one foot off the ground.
2. Point your toes and slowly rotate your ankle in circles.
3. Make several circles clockwise, then reverse to counterclockwise.
4. Repeat for the other ankle.
5. Maintain steady breathing and controlled motion.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly; Full range of motion; Relax foot; Rotate both directions

Распространённые ошибки: Rushed movements; Small circles; Not changing direction

Дыхание: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

name: Feet and Ankles Stretch
description:
A stretch to increase flexibility and mobility in the feet and ankle muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit or stand with legs extended or positioned comfortably.
2. Point your toes downward to stretch the top of your feet and fronts of your ankles.
3. Flex your toes upward toward your shins to stretch the calves and back of the ankles.
4. Hold each position for 15-30 seconds.
5. Repeat the sequence for several reps.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly through each phase; Hold gentle tension, do not force; Keep knees extended but soft; Breathe evenly

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing during the stretch; Overstretching or forcing range of motion; Holding breath

Дыхание: Breathe normally throughout, or exhale as you relax into each stretch.

name: Flat Bench Cable Fly
description:
A chest isolation exercise using cables while lying on a flat bench for continuous tension.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set a flat bench between two cable pulleys and attach handles.
2. Lie back and grip each handle with arms extended.
3. With elbows slightly bent, bring handles together above your chest.
4. Squeeze your chest at the top.
5. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

Подсказки по технике: Maintain slight elbow bend; Keep arms wide; Control both directions; Avoid overstretching

Распространённые ошибки: Locking elbows; Letting the cables slam back; Using too much weight

Дыхание: Exhale as you bring hands together, inhale as you return.

name: Flexion Leg Sit-Up Stretch
description:
A stretch that combines trunk flexion with leg movement to lengthen the abdominals and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Cross arms over chest or reach toward knees.
3. Contract abdominal muscles to sit up, curling your spine.
4. Reach for your knees at the top to enhance the stretch.
5. Lower back to starting position with control.

Подсказки по технике: Curl up slowly; Avoid pulling on neck; Engage core throughout; Keep feet flat

Распространённые ошибки: Jerking the movement; Using momentum instead of muscle; Straining the neck

Дыхание: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Floor Crunch
description:
A basic abdominal crunch performed lying on the floor to strengthen the rectus abdominis.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
2. Place hands lightly behind head or cross over chest.
3. Engage core and lift shoulders off the floor.
4. Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
5. Slowly return to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chin off chest; Lower back pressed to floor; Controlled movement; Exhale on crunch

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling on neck; Not engaging core; Using momentum; Not breathing properly

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Front Plank
description:
An isometric core stability exercise performed in a prone position to strengthen the abdominals and stabilize the entire body.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face down, placing forearms on the ground and elbows under shoulders.
2. Lift your body off the floor, supporting weight on forearms and toes.
3. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
4. Engage your core and glutes for stability.
5. Hold the position for the prescribed time, then lower to the ground.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core tight; Neutral spine; Do not let hips drop; Look down

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips drop or rise; Arched back; Not engaging the core

Дыхание: Breathe slowly and steadily during the hold.

name: Front Toe Touch Stretch
description:
A classic stretch where you bend forward to touch your toes, lengthening the hamstrings and lower back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand (or sit) with legs straight.
2. Bend slowly forward from the hips, keeping a flat back.
3. Reach towards or touch your toes with your hands.
4. Keep knees straight but not locked.
5. Hold stretch, then return to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Hinge at hips; Keep head in line with spine; Reach gently, don’t bounce; Keep legs straight
