Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the back excessively; Bouncing or forcing the stretch; Locking the knees

Дыхание: Exhale as you bend forward, inhale as you return upright.

name: Glute Bridge
description:
A floor-based exercise that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings by lifting the hips.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Start lying on back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart.
2. Arms rest at sides, palms down.
3. Push through heels, lifting hips toward ceiling.
4. Pause and squeeze glutes at top.
5. Lower hips back to floor.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through heels; Squeeze glutes; Don't overarch back; Keep knees in line

Распространённые ошибки: Pushing through toes; Flaring ribs; Rushing movement

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

name: Hanging Leg Hip Raise
description:
A hanging core exercise where you raise your knees and curl your hips upward to train the abs and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Hang from the bar with both hands and let your body settle into a dead hang.
2. Pull your ribs down and brace your midsection to stop excess swinging.
3. Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest by curling your hips upward.
4. Raise until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor or your knees reach hip height.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso steady.
6. Lower your legs with control until you return to a full hang.

Подсказки по технике: Curl pelvis up; Control the swing; Ribs down; Lift knees, not shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the body to start each rep; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Dropping the legs quickly on the way down; Only lifting the knees halfway with no hip curl

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise your knees and curl your hips up; inhale as you lower back to the hang.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
description:
A core exercise performed while hanging, lifting straight legs to target the abdominals and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended.
2. Keep legs together and straight.
3. Engage core and lift legs up to parallel or higher.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower legs under control to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Avoid swinging; Lift with core, not momentum; Keep legs straight; Control leg descent

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the body; Using momentum; Bending knees or arching back

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift legs, inhale as you lower.

name: Hip Circles Stretch
description:
A dynamic stretch to increase mobility in the hips by performing circular leg movements.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips.
2. Lift one knee up in front of you.
3. Move your knee and thigh in a circular motion outward.
4. Reverse and perform circles inward after the set.
5. Switch legs and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Move leg from the hip; Keep upper body stable; Smooth, controlled circles; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Rushing the circles; Swinging the whole body; Holding breath

Дыхание: Inhale and exhale naturally during the stretch.

name: Hip Extension Stretch
description:
A stretch focused on extending the hip to target tight hip flexors and anterior hips.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face down with legs extended.
2. Place hands beneath shoulders, elbows bent.
3. Press palms into floor, lifting chest and gently extending hips.
4. Hold the stretch at a comfortable tension.
5. Slowly lower back down.

Подсказки по технике: Avoid excessive back arch; Keep hips on floor; Press through palms; Stretch gradually

Распространённые ошибки: Overarching the lower back; Forcing the stretch; Holding breath

Дыхание: Inhale while preparing, exhale as you press up into stretch.

name: Hip Flexor and Quadriceps Stretch
description:
A stretch that lengthens the hip flexors and quadriceps by using a kneeling or lunge position.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Begin in a half-kneeling position, one knee down, one foot forward.
2. Keep torso upright with hands on hips or front knee.
3. Push hips forward slightly to increase the stretch.
4. Feel the stretch in the hip flexor and thigh of the back leg.
5. Hold for desired time, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core engaged; Torso upright; Push hips forward gently; Don't arch lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning forward; Arching lower back; Letting front knee go past toes

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

name: Incline Leg Hip Raise
description:
A core exercise where legs and hips are raised while lying on an incline, targeting the lower abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face up on an incline bench and grip the handles behind your head.
2. Extend your legs straight and keep them together.
3. Raise your legs towards your chest, lifting your hips off the bench.
4. Pause at the top, focusing on contracting your abs.
5. Lower your legs under control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep legs straight; Lift hips at top; Control lowering; Don't use momentum

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging legs; Arching lower back excessively; Not performing full hip lift

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower legs.

name: Incline Push-Up
description:
A push-up variation with hands elevated, reducing resistance on the chest and triceps.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Place hands shoulder-width apart on elevated surface.
2. Extend legs back with feet together, forming a straight line.
3. Lower chest toward the surface, elbows at 45 degrees.
4. Pause when chest is just above the surface.
5. Push back up to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Maintain straight line body; Core engaged; Lower under control; Exhale as you push up

Распространённые ошибки: Sagging hips; Flaring elbows out; Incomplete range of motion

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.

name: Inverted Row Between Chairs
description:
A bodyweight pulling exercise performed using a bar or sturdy broomstick supported between two chairs.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Set up a sturdy bar between two heavy chairs.
2. Lie underneath with your chest directly below the bar.
3. Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
4. Brace your body, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
5. Pull your chest to the bar, pause, then lower yourself slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Keep your body straight; Squeeze shoulder blades; Don't let hips sag; Pull to chest, not neck

Распространённые ошибки: Allowing hips to drop; Flared elbows; Not lowering all the way; Not squeezing shoulder blades

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Inverted Row With Straps
description:
A bodyweight upper-back row using suspension straps, pulling your chest toward the handles while keeping your body straight.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the straps to about chest height and stand facing the anchor point.
2. Grab the handles with an overhand grip and walk your feet forward until your body leans back in a straight line.
3. Brace your core and keep your heels planted with your arms fully extended.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Pause briefly when your hands reach your ribs or chest.
6. Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep body in one line; Drive elbows back; Squeeze shoulder blades; Keep shoulders down

Распространённые ошибки: Hips sag or pike instead of staying straight; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Pulling with bent wrists and loose handles; Letting the body drop quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower yourself away from the handles, and exhale as you pull your chest toward them.

name: Iron Cross Stretch
description:
A lying rotational stretch that improves spinal mobility and stretches the obliques and lower back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms extended out to the sides.
2. Lift one leg straight up towards the ceiling.
3. Sweep the raised leg across your body to the opposite side.
4. Allow your foot to touch or lower towards the floor.
5. Hold the stretch, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Shoulders stay flat; Sweep leg slowly; Breathe deeply into stretch; Relax into the twist

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting shoulders off the floor; Twisting too quickly; Holding breath; Allowing hips to pop up

Дыхание: Exhale as you move into the twist, inhale as you return to center.

name: Jackknife
description:
A Pilates core exercise involving lifting hips and legs up and overhead to strengthen the abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms at your sides and legs extended.
2. Engage your core and lift legs towards the ceiling.
3. Continue lifting hips off the mat, reaching feet upward.
4. Pause at the top with hips elevated.
5. Slowly roll back down vertebra by vertebra.

Подсказки по технике: Keep legs straight; Lift with core; Control the descent; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Letting legs fall too quickly; Arching the back excessively; Pushing with arms

Дыхание: Exhale while lifting up, inhale while lowering down.

name: Jackknife Floor
description:
A dynamic ab exercise where you simultaneously raise legs and torso to touch in a 'V' position.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
2. Engage your core, lift arms and legs toward each other.
3. Reach hands toward feet, forming a 'V' at the top.
4. Pause briefly, squeezing at the top.
5. Lower back down slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep legs straight; Lift arms and legs together; Do not swing; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Bending knees or elbows too much; Heaving with momentum; Letting lower back arch

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

name: Jackknife Split Crunch
description:
A crunch variation combining a V-up with a leg split to target the abs and hip flexors.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
2. Engage your core and simultaneously lift your torso and legs off the ground.
3. As you rise, spread your legs into a split while reaching your hands toward your feet.
4. Pause at the top, squeezing your abs.
5. Lower your legs and torso back to the ground with control, bringing feet together.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core tight; Don't arch lower back; Lead with chest; Controlled split

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the legs; Using momentum; Arching the lower back

Дыхание: Exhale when crunching up, inhale when lowering down.

name: Jump Rope
description:
A cardio exercise where you turn a rope with your hands and perform repeated small jumps as it passes under your feet.

Оборудование: канат

Техника выполнения:
1. Hold a handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels.
2. Stand tall with feet close together and elbows tucked by your sides.
3. Turn the rope with your wrists and swing it up overhead.
4. Hop just high enough to clear the rope as it passes under your feet.
5. Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
6. Keep the rope moving in a smooth rhythm and repeat each jump.

Подсказки по технике: Turn with the wrists; Stay light on your feet; Jump only as needed; Keep elbows close

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the arms in big circles instead of using the wrists; Jumping too high off the floor on each rep; Landing flat-footed or with stiff knees; Letting the hands drift wide away from the hips

Дыхание: Breathe steadily and naturally, exhaling softly every few jumps while keeping a relaxed rhythm.

name: Jump Step-Up
description:
A plyometric exercise involving stepping and jumping onto a raised surface to build leg power and coordination.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand facing a sturdy box or platform.
2. Place one foot firmly on top of the box.
3. Drive through the heel and explode upward, lifting your other knee high.
4. Land softly on the box with both feet.
5. Step or jump down with control and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive explosively through the lead leg; Land softly; Keep chest lifted; Use arms for balance

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the knee cave inward; Landing hard or flat-footed; Not using full range of motion

Дыхание: Exhale during the jump, inhale as you land and reset.

name: Jumping Jack
description:
A dynamic total-body movement for cardiovascular and muscular endurance.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Start with feet together and arms relaxed at your sides.
2. Jump feet out to shoulder-width as you raise arms overhead.
3. Briefly touch hands or keep arms straight above head.
4. Jump feet back together and arms down to sides.
5. Repeat at a brisk pace.

Подсказки по технике: Land softly; Keep core engaged; Full arm extension; Stay light on feet

Распространённые ошибки: Slapping feet; Incomplete arm raise; Landing hard on heels

Дыхание: Breathe evenly throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description:
A hip hinge movement using a kettlebell from the floor to standing, building posterior chain and grip strength.

Оборудование: гиря

Техника выполнения:
1. Place kettlebell between your feet; stand with feet hip-width apart.
2. Hinge at hips and bend knees, keeping back flat and chest up.
3. Grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
4. Drive through your heels to stand up, fully extending hips and knees.
5. Lower the kettlebell to the floor under control by hinging at the hips.

Подсказки по технике: Flat back; Push through heels; Engage glutes; Keep kettlebell close

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back; Letting kettlebell drift from body; Locking knees early; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Kneeling Back Rotation Stretch
description:
A mobility stretch that improves thoracic spine rotation while kneeling, also opening the chest and shoulders.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Kneel on the floor (all fours or lunge position).
2. Place one hand behind your head or neck.
3. Rotate elbow and upper body upward, opening chest.
4. Hold for a moment at top of rotation.
5. Return to start and repeat; switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips stable; Open chest fully; Rotate through upper back; Move slowly

Распространённые ошибки: Rotating through lower back; Forcing the stretch; Letting hips move

Дыхание: Exhale as you rotate, inhale returning to start.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
description:
A floor stretch to lengthen the latissimus dorsi and improve shoulder mobility.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Kneel and sit hips back on heels.
2. Reach both arms forward, palms on floor.
3. Push chest toward the ground.
4. Hold the stretch, focusing on the long side body.
5. Optionally shift hands to each side for more stretch.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms straight; Reach fingertips forward; Drop chest down; Relax neck and shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back excessively; Bending elbows too much; Letting hips lift off heels; Tensing shoulders

Дыхание: Inhale deeply as you reach forward, exhale as you sink deeper into the stretch.

name: Kneeling Triceps Stretch
description:
A static stretch targeting the triceps and lats by flexing the elbow overhead while kneeling.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Kneel on the floor or mat.
2. Raise one arm overhead then bend the elbow so your hand touches your upper back.
3. Use your other hand to gently push on the bent elbow.
4. Hold the stretch.
5. Switch arms and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back straight; Elbow points up; Gently press, don’t force; Relax neck and shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the back; Pushing too hard; Letting elbow flare out

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

name: Landmine 180
description:
A rotating landmine core exercise where you swing the barbell side to side using your hips, shoulders, and obliques.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand facing the free end of the barbell with your feet about shoulder-width apart, and hold the barbell sleeve with both hands in front of your chest.
2. Bend your knees slightly, brace your midsection, and keep your arms long but not locked.
3. Rotate your shoulders and hips together to lower the barbell toward one hip.
4. Drive through your feet and rotate across your body to sweep the barbell in an arc toward the opposite side.
5. Control the barbell as it changes direction, and continue rotating side to side with your chest facing the barbell.
6. Keep the movement smooth and balanced on both sides until the set is complete.

Подсказки по технике: Rotate hips and shoulders together; Brace your core; Move the bar in an arc; Stay tall through the chest

Распространённые ошибки: Twisting only the arms while the torso stays still; Letting the lower back arch as the bar moves; Locking the knees and staying flat-footed; Jerking the bar instead of controlling the arc

Дыхание: Inhale as the barbell moves to one side, and exhale as you rotate it across to the other side.

name: Leg Raise Crunch
description:
An ab exercise combining a crunch with a leg raise to emphasize upper and lower abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back and extend your legs.
2. Place your hands by your sides or behind your head.
3. Simultaneously lift your legs and upper torso toward each other.
4. Squeeze at the top of the movement.
5. Lower your legs and upper body back down under control.

Подсказки по технике: Keep lower back pressed to floor; Move slowly; Exhale at the crunch; Don't use momentum

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the lower back; Using momentum; Neck strain from pulling

Дыхание: Exhale during the crunch, inhale as you return.

name: Leg Raise with Hip Lift
description:
A core exercise combining a leg raise with a hip lift to target the lower abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat with arms at your sides and legs straight.
2. Raise your legs up together towards the ceiling.
3. At the top of the movement, press your legs up by lifting your hips off the ground.
4. Pause, squeezing your abs.
5. Lower your hips and legs back to the starting position slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Keep legs together; Don’t swing; Lift hips with control; Keep back flat

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Arching lower back; Not controlling the descent

Дыхание: Exhale during hip lift, inhale during the descent.

name: Lever Back Extension
description:
A machine-based trunk extension that trains the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings by moving your torso against resistance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine so the back pad sits comfortably against your upper back and your feet are secured on the platform.
2. Sit tall against the pad and grip the handles or side bars.
3. Brace your core and lean your torso forward under control through the machine's range.
4. Stop at the bottom when you feel a comfortable stretch and keep your feet pressed into the platform.
5. Drive your torso back against the pad until you return to an upright position.
6. Repeat smoothly without bouncing or jerking the pad.

Подсказки по технике: Brace before you move; Move through a smooth arc; Keep feet firmly planted; Return to tall posture

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum and bouncing out of the bottom position; Pushing through a short, rushed range of motion; Letting the feet lift or shift on the platform; Hyperextending far past upright at the top

Дыхание: Inhale as you lean forward, then exhale as you extend back to an upright position.

name: Lever High Row
description:
A chest-supported machine row that trains the upper back by pulling handles from in front of you toward your torso.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so the handles start around upper-chest height when you sit down.
2. Sit with your chest firmly against the pad and place your feet flat on the platform.
3. Grab the handles with an overhand grip and straighten your arms without lifting your chest off the pad.
4. Pull the handles back toward your upper ribs by driving your elbows down and back.
5. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
6. Return the handles forward under control until your arms are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Chest stays on pad; Drive elbows back; Squeeze shoulder blades; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears as you pull; Leaning off the chest pad to move the weight; Letting the handles slam forward between reps; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the handles toward you, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

name: Lever Horizontal Leg Press
description:
A horizontal plate-loaded machine exercise targeting the entire thigh, especially the quadriceps.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the leg press and adjust seat as needed.
2. Place feet shoulder-width apart on platform.
3. Push platform away by extending legs.
4. Do not lock knees at the top position.
5. Lower platform under control to start position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep lower back pressed into seat; Do not lock knees; Feet flat and even pressure; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees cave in/out; Lifting hips off seat; Locking out knees; Using too much weight

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Lever Incline Hammer Chest Press
description:
A machine-based incline chest press emphasizing the upper chest and shoulders.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust seat height for optimal handle position.
2. Sit and grip handles with elbows bent.
3. Press handles up and forward above chest.
4. Avoid locking elbows completely.
5. Lower handles slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Press upward and slightly forward; Keep feet flat on floor; Don't shrug shoulders; Pause at top

Распространённые ошибки: Letting elbows flare too wide; Locking out elbows; Arching back off seat; Gripping handles unevenly

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Lever Kneeling Leg Curl
description:
A machine hamstring exercise done kneeling, curling the lower legs toward the glutes by bending the knees.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point and your ankles sit securely under the pads.
2. Kneel on the pad facing the machine, brace your torso against the support, and grip the handles.
3. Start with your legs extended behind you and keep your hips still.
4. Curl your heels up toward your glutes by bending your knees against the pads.
5. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your hamstrings.
6. Lower the pads under control until your legs are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips glued down; Curl through the knees; Move slowly on the way down; Squeeze hamstrings at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the hips off the pad during the curl; Swinging the legs to start each rep; Stopping short and not straightening the knees at the bottom; Letting the ankles slip out of the pads

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl your heels up, and inhale as you lower back to the start.

name: Lever Lateral Raise
description:
A machine shoulder isolation exercise where you lift your arms out to the sides to target the lateral delts.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so the machine arms line up with your shoulders when you sit down.
2. Sit with your back against the pad and place your forearms or hands on the machine pads or handles.
3. Start with your arms down at your sides and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
4. Raise the machine arms out to your sides until your upper arms reach shoulder height.
5. Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
6. Lower the arms back down under control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with the elbows; Keep shoulders down; Lift to shoulder height; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Swinging or bouncing the weight at the bottom; Lifting the arms far above shoulder height; Letting the back come off the pad

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise the arms out to the sides, and inhale as you lower them back down.

name: Lever Leg Extension
description:
A seated machine exercise that strengthens the quadriceps by extending the knees against a padded lever.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and backrest so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
2. Sit back against the pad and place your shins behind the lower roller pad.
3. Grip the handles and start with your knees bent and feet pointed forward.
4. Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are nearly straight.
5. Pause briefly while keeping your thighs pressed into the seat.
6. Lower the pad with control until your knees are bent again.

Подсказки по технике: Line up knees with pivot; Lift with your quads; Keep hips on the seat; Lower under control

Распространённые ошибки: Knees sit too far forward or behind the machine pivot.; Swinging the weight up with momentum.; Locking the knees hard at the top.; Lifting the hips or lower back off the seat.

Дыхание: Exhale as you straighten your knees, and inhale as you lower the pad back down.

name: Lever Lying Chest Press
description:
A plate-loaded machine press mimicking the bench press to target the entire chest safely.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie supine on the machine bench.
2. Grip the handles firmly, elbows bent.
3. Engage chest and press handles forward and up.
4. Fully extend arms without locking out elbows.
5. Slowly return to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep feet flat on floor; Don't overextend elbows; Press evenly with both arms; Squeeze chest at top

Распространённые ошибки: Letting shoulders roll forward; Lifting lower back off bench; Using too much weight; Allowing wrists to bend

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Lever Lying Leg Curl
description:
A machine hamstring exercise done face down by bending the knees to curl a padded lever toward the glutes.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad rests against the back of your lower legs above your heels.
2. Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and grab the handles or bench edges for support.
3. Press your hips into the pad and point your toes forward to set your start position.
4. Curl the pad upward by bending your knees until your heels move toward your glutes.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips down and thighs on the pad.
6. Lower the pad back down under control until your legs are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips glued down; Curl through the hamstrings; Move slow on the way down; Knees stay in line

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the hips off the pad at the top; Using momentum to swing the pad upward; Stopping short and not fully lowering the pad; Feet turning sharply inward or outward during the curl

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the pad up, and inhale as you lower it back down under control.

name: Lever Preacher Curl
description:
A machine biceps curl done with the upper arms braced on a preacher pad to isolate elbow flexion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so your armpits sit close to the top of the preacher pad.
2. Sit down and place the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
3. Grip the machine handles with an underhand grip and straighten your arms to the start.
4. Keep your chest up and curl the handles toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
5. Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top without lifting your upper arms off the pad.
6. Lower the handles under control until your arms are nearly straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep upper arms glued down; Curl only at the elbows; Lift smooth, lower slower; Keep wrists neutral

Распространённые ошибки: Upper arms lifting off the pad as the handles rise; Using the shoulders or rocking the torso to start the curl; Letting the weight drop quickly on the way down; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them straight

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the handles up, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

name: Lever Reverse Hyperextension
description:
A machine glute and hamstring exercise where you raise your legs behind you while lying face down on a pad.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine so your hips rest on the pad and your legs can hang freely.
2. Lie face down with your torso supported and grip the handles or sides for stability.
3. Place your feet against the foot pads and let your legs hang down under control.
4. Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes to raise your legs behind you.
5. Lift until your legs are about in line with your torso without arching your lower back.
6. Lower your legs slowly to the start position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lift with your glutes; Keep hips on the pad; Control the swing; Stop at torso level

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the legs up with momentum; Arching the lower back at the top; Letting the hips slide off the pad; Bending and straightening the knees during each rep

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your legs, and exhale as you raise them behind you.

name: Lever Reverse T-Bar Row
description:
A chest-supported leverage machine row using an overhand grip to train the upper back, biceps, and forearms.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat or chest pad so the handles line up around mid-chest when you reach forward.
2. Place your chest firmly against the pad and set your feet flat on the platform.
3. Grab the handles with an overhand grip and straighten your arms without rounding your shoulders.
4. Pull the handles toward your chest by driving your elbows back and out slightly.
5. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
6. Lower the handles under control until your arms are straight again.

Подсказки по технике: Chest stays on pad; Lead with your elbows; Squeeze shoulder blades together; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Bouncing the chest off the pad to move the handles; Letting the upper back round at the start; Yanking the weight and dropping it back fast

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the handles toward your chest, and inhale as you lower them back under control.

name: Lever Seated Calf Raise
description:
A seated machine calf exercise where you raise and lower your heels to train the soleus through ankle plantarflexion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so the thigh pad rests securely on your thighs with your knees bent about 90 degrees.
2. Place the balls of your feet on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
3. Grip the handles or seat and lift your heels to take the weight onto your calves.
4. Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your toes planted.
6. Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves, then repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through big toe; Lift heels straight up; Control the lowering; Keep knees still

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control.; Letting the knees shift up and down during the rep.; Rolling the feet outward or inward on the platform.; Using only a short top-half range of motion.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

name: Lever Seated Crunch
description:
A machine exercise that isolates and strengthens the abdominal muscles through spinal flexion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust seat and select appropriate resistance.
2. Sit back and secure feet and handles as designed.
3. Engage abs and flex spine forward in a crunch motion.
4. Bring chest toward knees while exhaling.
5. Control return to start and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Move with abs, not hips; Don't use momentum; Controlled movement; Full range of motion

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hip flexors dominate; Using excessive weight; Rushing reps; Partial range of motion

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch down, inhale as you return up.

name: Lever Seated Dip
description:
A machine-based dip that targets the triceps, chest, and shoulders in a seated position.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and select appropriate weight.
2. Sit down and grip the handles firmly.
3. Press the handles downward by extending your arms fully.
4. Pause briefly at lockout.
5. Return to the start position slowly.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows close; Control the descent; Do not lock elbows; Sit upright

Распространённые ошибки: Allowing elbows to flare out; Using excessive weight; Swinging or jerking movement

Дыхание: Exhale on pressing down, inhale on returning up.

name: Lever Seated Hip Abduction
description:
A seated machine exercise where you press your legs outward against pads to train the hip abductors and outer glutes.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees and the thigh pads rest against the outside of your legs.
2. Sit tall with your back against the pad, place your feet on the footrests, and grip the handles.
3. Start with your legs together and your knees aligned with the machine's pivot.
4. Drive your knees outward against the pads until your legs are as wide as your comfortable range allows.
5. Pause briefly with your hips still on the seat.
6. Bring your legs back together slowly until the pads nearly touch, then repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Sit tall; Drive knees out; Control the return; Keep hips on seat

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning the torso forward or rocking back to move the weight.; Letting the legs snap back together on the return.; Lifting the hips off the seat at the widest point.; Turning the feet excessively to cheat the movement.

Дыхание: Exhale as you press your knees outward, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

name: Lever Seated Hip Adduction
description:
A seated machine exercise that trains the inner thighs by bringing the legs together against resistance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and pads so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
2. Sit tall with your back against the pad, place your legs outside the thigh pads, and grab the handles.
3. Set your feet flat on the footrests and start with your legs comfortably apart.
4. Bring your legs together by pressing inward against the pads.
5. Squeeze your inner thighs briefly when the pads come together.
6. Return the pads outward slowly until you reach the start position without letting the weight slam.

Подсказки по технике: Sit tall; Control both directions; Squeeze inner thighs; Keep hips still

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning forward or lifting the lower back off the pad.; Letting the pads fly open on the way back.; Using short, bouncing reps instead of controlled motion.; Turning the feet and knees excessively to force the movement.

Дыхание: Exhale as you press your legs together, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

name: Lever Seated Leg Curl
description:
A seated machine hamstring exercise where you bend your knees to pull a padded lever downward.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and pad so your knees line up with the machine’s pivot point.
2. Sit back against the pad and place your lower legs under the roller just above your ankles.
3. Grip the handles and keep your thighs pressed into the seat.
4. Curl the pad down by bending your knees until your heels move toward the floor.
5. Pause briefly and squeeze your hamstrings at the bottom.
6. Lower the pad back up with control until your knees are nearly straight.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips glued down; Curl through the heels; Move only at knees; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the hips off the seat during the curl.; Using momentum and swinging the pad through the rep.; Letting the knees fully lock out at the top.; Setting the pad too high on the calves instead of above the ankles.

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the pad down, and inhale as you return it to the starting position.

name: Lever Seated Reverse Fly
description:
A machine rear-delt exercise where you pull the handles out and back while seated with your chest supported.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so the handles are about shoulder height when you sit down.
2. Sit with your chest against the pad, feet flat on the floor, and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
3. Start with your arms in front of you and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
4. Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your upper arms line up with your shoulders.
5. Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the end of the movement.
6. Return the handles slowly to the start without letting the weight slam down.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with your elbows; Keep chest on the pad; Soft bend in elbows; Squeeze shoulder blades together

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Straightening the elbows and turning it into a press; Letting the chest come off the pad; Swinging the handles back with momentum

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the handles back, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

name: Lever Shrug
description:
A machine trap exercise where you lift your shoulders straight up against the handles to train the upper trapezius.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine so the handles rest at your sides with your shoulders relaxed.
2. Sit or stand against the pad and grasp the handles with a firm overhand grip.
3. Straighten your arms and set your chest tall with your neck neutral.
4. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso still.
6. Lower your shoulders under control until they return to the start.

Подсказки по технике: Shoulders straight up; Arms stay long; Keep chest tall; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows and turning it into a row; Rolling the shoulders forward or backward; Leaning the torso to move the weight; Jutting the chin forward as the shoulders rise

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you shrug your shoulders up, then inhale as you lower back down.

name: Lever Standing Calf Raise
description:
A machine calf exercise where you raise and lower your heels under shoulder pads to train the calves through ankle movement.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the shoulder pads so they rest comfortably on your shoulders when you stand on the platform.
2. Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform with your heels hanging off and grip the handles.
3. Straighten your legs, brace your torso, and let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves.
4. Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while staying balanced under the pads.
6. Lower your heels under control back to the stretched start position.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through big toe; Lift heels straight up; Use full ankle range; Control the lowering

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control.; Bending the knees noticeably during the raise.; Rolling the ankles inward or outward as the heels lift.; Using a short range and stopping before the heels fully lower.

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

name: Lever Standing Hip Extension
description:
A machine-based hip extension to isolate and strengthen the glutes.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the machine to your height.
2. Place one foot on platform, chest against pad.
3. Brace core and grasp handles for balance.
4. Extend hip, pressing lever back with heel.
5. Return to starting position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through heel; Keep knee slightly bent; Don't arch lower back; Pause at top briefly

Распространённые ошибки: Excessive lower back arch; Using momentum; Letting knee lock out; Not completing full extension

Дыхание: Exhale as you extend hip, inhale as you return.

name: Lever Standing Rear Kick
description:
A leverage machine exercise that isolates the glutes with a hip extension rear kick motion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the lever machine pad to chest height and select weight.
2. Place working foot on the platform.
3. Hold handles and brace core.
4. Extend hip by pushing foot backward as far as comfortable.
5. Return slowly to starting position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with heel; Keep core tight; Avoid arching the back; Squeeze glute at top

Распространённые ошибки: Using lower back to lift; Swinging leg with momentum; Not controlling the negative

Дыхание: Exhale as you kick back, inhale as you return.

name: Lever T-Bar Row
description:
A machine row movement that maximizes mid-back and lat development through a horizontal pulling pattern.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie prone on the chest pad of the T-bar row machine and grasp the handles.
2. Brace your upper body and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Pull the handles toward your chest or lower ribs.
4. Pause and squeeze your back at the top.
5. Lower the weight under control to a full stretch.

Подсказки по технике: Pinch shoulder blades; Drive elbows back; Keep chest on pad; Full stretch at bottom

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Not fully extending arms; Bouncing weights; Letting shoulders round forward

Дыхание: Exhale as you row up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Lever Triceps Extension
description:
A seated leverage machine exercise where you bend and straighten the elbows to train the triceps.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so the handles line up with about eye or forehead level when you sit down.
2. Sit with your back against the pad and place your feet flat on the floor.
3. Grip the handles with your palms facing down and straighten your arms in front of you.
4. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the handles toward your forehead.
5. Pause briefly when your elbows are fully bent and the handles are close to your head.
6. Press the handles away by straightening your elbows until your arms are extended again.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows tucked; Upper arms stay still; Move only at elbows; Control both directions

Распространённые ошибки: Elbows flare wide out to the sides.; Shoulders roll forward and the chest collapses.; Handles are dropped quickly toward the head.; Upper arms swing back and forth during the rep.

Дыхание: Inhale as you bend your elbows to lower the handles, and exhale as you straighten your arms to press them away.

name: Lying Hip Lift on Stability Ball
originalName: Lying Hip Lift on Stability Ball
description:
A hip-thrusting exercise using a stability ball to engage glutes, hamstrings, and core.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms by your sides and feet on the stability ball.
2. Bend knees at 90 degrees and keep feet hip-width apart.
3. Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
4. Pause at the top, keeping your body in a straight line.
5. Lower your hips back down with control.

Подсказки по технике: Press through heels; Squeeze glutes; Keep core engaged; Avoid overextending back

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees collapse; Overarching lower back; Dropping hips too low

Дыхание: Exhale when lifting hips, inhale when lowering hips.

name: Lying Leg Raise
description:
A bodyweight exercise that targets the lower abdominal muscles by lifting the legs while lying flat.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back, legs straight.
2. Keep arms at your sides or under hips.
3. Lift legs upward, keeping knees straight.
4. Raise legs until hips come up slightly.
5. Lower legs slowly without touching the floor.

Подсказки по технике: Engage core; Keep lower back down; Control descent; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Using momentum; Touching feet to ground between reps

Дыхание: Exhale as you raise legs, inhale as you lower.

name: Lying Quadriceps Stretch
description:
A stretch for the quadriceps performed lying on the stomach for maximal knee flexion.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your stomach with legs extended.
2. Bend one knee, bringing heel toward glute.
3. Reach back and grasp ankle with hand.
4. Gently pull heel closer to glute until a stretch is felt.
5. Hold, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Knees together; Relax neck; Do not force; Hips flat

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling too hard; Letting pelvis lift; Knee splaying out

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull, inhale to release.

name: Lying Scissor Kick
description:
A core and hip flexor exercise performed while lying flat, alternately raising and lowering legs in a scissor-like motion.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides.
2. Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, keeping them straight.
3. Alternate raising one leg while lowering the other in a scissor motion.
4. Continue to alternate legs in a controlled manner.
5. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed, core engaged.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core braced; Move legs with control; Don't touch floor; Point toes

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Moving too fast; Letting legs touch ground

Дыхание: Exhale as legs rise, inhale as legs lower.

name: Lying Straight Leg Raise
description:
An exercise to isolate the hip flexors and lower abdominals from a supine position.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back, arms at sides.
2. Extend legs fully, feet together.
3. Lift legs straight up to vertical.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower legs down slowly but don’t touch floor.

Подсказки по технике: Keep lower back flat; Control leg movement; Squeeze abs; Don’t let heels touch

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Using momentum; Separation of legs

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift legs, inhale as you lower.

name: Medicine Ball Wall Sit-Up
description:
A dynamic core exercise involving a sit-up while throwing and catching a medicine ball against a wall.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the floor facing a wall, knees bent.
2. Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
3. Lie back, then perform a sit-up.
4. At the top, throw the ball against the wall.
5. Catch the rebound and lower back down.

Подсказки по технике: Engage abs; Full range of motion; Coordinate throw and catch; Keep feet grounded

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning too far back; Using arms instead of core; Missing the ball

Дыхание: Exhale as you sit up/throw, inhale as you lower down.

name: Middle Back Stretch
description:
A static stretch to lengthen the muscles of the thoracic (middle) back region.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit or stand with feet hip-width apart.
2. Extend your arms straight in front and clasp your hands.
3. Round your upper back and push your hands forward.
4. Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest.
5. Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds and release.

Подсказки по технике: Round your upper back; Keep arms extended; Relax your shoulders; Hold the position steady

Распространённые ошибки: Arching the lower back instead of rounding the upper back; Holding breath; Bouncing during the stretch

Дыхание: Breathe slowly and evenly throughout the stretch.

name: Military Press
description:
A standing barbell press that builds overall shoulder strength and stability.

Оборудование: штанга

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart and barbell at shoulder height.
2. Grip the bar with hands just outside shoulder-width.
3. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
4. Press the barbell overhead to full arm extension.
5. Lower the bar slowly back to shoulders.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core tight; Press in a straight line; Avoid arching lower back; Lock elbows at the top

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning back excessively; Bouncing the bar off shoulders; Flaring elbows too wide; Not bringing bar below chin

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Neck Side Stretch
description:
A gentle static stretch that targets the side muscles of the neck, improving mobility and reducing tension.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit or stand with good posture.
2. Slowly tilt your head to one side, ear towards shoulder.
3. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
4. Return to center.
5. Repeat on the opposite side.

Подсказки по технике: Don't shrug shoulders; Keep shoulders level; Move slowly; Feel a gentle stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Forcing the stretch; Turning the head instead of tilting; Using jerky movements

Дыхание: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

name: Old School Reverse Extensions
description:
This bodyweight movement isolates the triceps by extending the elbows while lying face down.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face down on the floor or bench with elbows bent and hands at your sides.
2. Position elbows by your torso.
3. Straighten your arms fully behind you, contracting your triceps.
4. Pause and squeeze at full extension.
5. Return to the start in a controlled manner.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows tight to torso; Extend arms fully; Squeeze triceps at the top; Avoid swinging arms

Распространённые ошибки: Using body momentum; Not achieving full extension; Letting elbows flare out

Дыхание: Exhale as you extend your arms, inhale as you return.

name: Otis-Up
description:
A sit-up variation holding a weight at arm’s length overhead to increase abdominal engagement.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet anchored.
2. Hold a weight with both hands, arms fully extended above your chest.
3. Engage your core and sit up, keeping arms straight and weight overhead.
4. Reach an upright seated position.
5. Lower yourself back down under control with arms extended.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms locked out; Do not swing weight; Engage abs fully; Maintain slow control

Распространённые ошибки: Bending arms; Dropping weight forward; Using momentum to sit up

Дыхание: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Overhead Chest Stretch
description:
A static stretch that opens the chest by extending the arms overhead and pulling back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright with feet hip-width apart.
2. Interlace fingers and stretch arms straight overhead.
3. Gently pull arms back behind head.
4. Squeeze shoulder blades together.
5. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms straight; Open the chest; Maintain tall posture; Avoid arching lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Hyperextending lower back; Bending elbows; Letting shoulders shrug

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description:
A machine-based isolation exercise focusing on squeezing the chest muscles through a fly motion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust seat and sit with back against pad.
2. Place forearms on pads with elbows slightly bent.
3. Bring arms together in a wide arc.
4. Squeeze chest at the end of movement.
5. Return slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows soft; Squeeze chest at peak; Maintain back on pad; Control return phase

Распространённые ошибки: Locking elbows; Arching lower back; Using too much weight

Дыхание: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you open.

name: Peroneals Stretch
description:
A static stretch that targets the outside muscles of the lower leg.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with one leg crossed over the other.
2. Grasp the foot and gently pull it inward.
3. Turn the sole toward your midline.
4. Hold for 20-30 seconds.
5. Switch sides and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Gentle stretch; Don't force movement; Keep knee straight; Hold steady

Распространённые ошибки: Stretching too forcefully; Not holding long enough; Incorrect foot positioning

Дыхание: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

name: Pilates Corkscrew
description:
A Pilates core exercise where the legs draw a circular motion to challenge abdominal stability.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on back, arms by side, legs straight up.
2. Engage core, lift hips off mat gently.
3. Circle legs together in a clockwise motion.
4. Lower hips as legs complete the circle.
5. Reverse the circle direction.

Подсказки по технике: Abs tight; Control the motion; Keep shoulders down; Slow and steady

Распространённые ошибки: Arching lower back; Swinging legs; Holding breath

Дыхание: Exhale as you circle legs, inhale to prepare.

name: Pilates Hundred
description:
A classic Pilates exercise involving rhythmic arm pumps and core engagement.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on back, legs in tabletop or extended.
2. Lift head, neck, shoulders off mat.
3. Extend arms at sides, hovering above floor.
4. Pump arms up and down vigorously.
5. Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps; repeat to 100.

Подсказки по технике: Engage core; Keep lower back down; Strong arm pulses; Steady breath

Распространённые ошибки: Neck strain; Arching lower back; Rapid, shallow breathing

Дыхание: Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps, continue cycle.

name: Plyometric Side Lunge Stretch
description:
A dynamic stretch to warm up and mobilize the hips, inner thighs, and legs.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet wider than hip-width apart.
2. Shift your weight to one side, bending the knee and keeping the opposite leg straight.
3. Drop into a deep lunge while maintaining upright posture.
4. Push off the bent leg and return to starting position.
5. Repeat to the opposite side in a dynamic, alternating fashion.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Push hips back; Knee in line with toes; Alternate sides smoothly

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knee cave inward; Lifting heel off the ground; Rounding the back

Дыхание: Inhale as you prepare and exhale moving into each lunge.

name: Pull-Up (Wide Grip)
description:
A pull-up variation performed with a wide, overhand grip to emphasize the upper lats and back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grip pull-up bar with hands wider than shoulders, palms overhand.
2. Hang with arms fully extended and core tight.
3. Pull chest up to bar, driving elbows down and out.
4. Pause at the top, squeeze back muscles.
5. Lower down slowly to full extension.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows flared out; Lead with chest; Engage lats; Avoid swinging

Распространённые ошибки: Partial reps; Using momentum; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Pull-Up / Chin-Up
description:
A bodyweight pulling exercise that develops lat and upper body strength using a hanging bar.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with your chosen grip (overhand for pull-up, underhand for chin-up).
2. Hang at full arm extension with shoulders engaged.
3. Brace your core and pull your chest up toward the bar by driving elbows down.
4. Clear the bar with your chin or chest as you squeeze your lats.
5. Lower yourself under control to the starting hang position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with chest; Drive elbows down; Don't swing; Engage shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Not going to full hang; Using leg kick or swing; Chin not over the bar; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Push-Up
description:
A bodyweight exercise performed in a prone position, targeting the chest, shoulders, and triceps.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Begin in a plank with hands under shoulders.
2. Engage core and glutes.
3. Lower chest toward floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
4. Pause briefly when close to ground.
5. Press back up to plank position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep body straight; Engage core; Elbows 45 degrees; Lower under control

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips sag; Flaring elbows too wide; Incomplete range of motion

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.

name: Rear Decline Bridge
description:
A bodyweight floor bridge that lifts the hips to train the glutes and hamstrings while keeping the shoulders on the ground.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Place your arms by your sides and press your palms lightly into the floor.
3. Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes.
4. Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your knees, hips, and shoulders line up.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your ribs down.
6. Lower your hips to the floor with control and reset before the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through your heels; Squeeze glutes at the top; Keep ribs down; Don't arch your low back

Распространённые ошибки: Pushing through the toes so the heels lift; Overarching the lower back at the top; Letting the knees cave inward; Dropping the hips quickly to the floor

Дыхание: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale again as you lower with control.

name: Rear Deltoid Stretch
description:
A stretch that targets the rear shoulder to enhance flexibility and reduce tension.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Extend one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
2. Use opposite hand to pull arm towards your body.
3. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
4. Release and return to start.
5. Repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Relax shoulder; Arm stays at shoulder height; Gentle pull; No twisting torso

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting the shoulder; Twisting the upper body; Forcing the stretch

Дыхание: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

name: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
originalName: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
description:
A deep hip flexor stretch with the rear foot elevated for improved flexibility.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with your back to a bench; place one foot on the bench.
2. Step the front foot forward and lower into a lunge.
3. Tuck pelvis under, keeping chest tall.
4. Lean gently forward to intensify the stretch.
5. Hold, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Torso upright; Pelvis tucked; Front knee over ankle; Breathe

Распространённые ошибки: Overarching lower back; Knee traveling past toes; Leaning forward

Дыхание: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you sink into the stretch.

name: Resistance Band High Fly
description:
A chest isolation movement where resistance bands are used to fly arms downward from above shoulder height.

Оборудование: резиновая лента

Техника выполнения:
1. Anchor resistance band above shoulder height.
2. Grasp handles and step forward for tension.
3. Start with arms raised wide, aligned with shoulders.
4. Pull arms downward and together in a wide arc.
5. Squeeze chest, then return slowly to start.

Подсказки по технике: Keep slight bend in elbows; Control movement; Squeeze chest at bottom; Don't let band snap back

Распространённые ошибки: Overextending elbows; Letting shoulders shrug; Losing tension at top

Дыхание: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you return.

name: Reverse Crunch
description:
A bodyweight abs exercise lifting the hips toward the chest to target the lower abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back, arms at your sides, knees bent, and feet off the ground.
2. Engage your core and lift your legs, bringing knees toward your chest.
3. Lift hips off the floor in a curling motion.
4. Pause and squeeze your abs at the top.
5. Lower your hips back down slowly, keeping control.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly; Don't swing legs; Keep core braced; Avoid arching lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum to swing legs; Not controlling the descent; Letting lower back arch off the floor

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

name: Reverse Dip Stretch
description:
A stretch targeting the triceps and shoulders by extending the arms behind the body and lowering the torso.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with legs extended and arms behind your hips.
2. Place hands flat on the floor, fingers pointing forward.
3. Press through your palms to lift your chest up.
4. Keep your arms long without locking elbows.
5. Hold for the stretch, then slowly lower and relax.

Подсказки по технике: Lift chest tall; Keep elbows soft; Open shoulders; Avoid slumping

Распространённые ошибки: Locking elbows tightly; Letting shoulders round forward; Overarching lower back

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

name: Reverse Grip Machine Lat Pulldown
description:
A machine pulldown using an underhand grip to train the lats through a vertical pulling motion.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat so your knees fit snugly under the pads and place your feet flat on the floor.
2. Reach up and grab the handles with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
3. Sit tall with your chest up and arms fully extended overhead.
4. Pull the handles down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
5. Squeeze your upper back and lats at the bottom without leaning far backward.
6. Slowly let the handles rise until your arms are straight again while keeping control.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Drive elbows down; Keep wrists straight; Control the return

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning far back and turning it into a row; Pulling the handles behind the neck; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Letting the weight slam back at the top

Дыхание: Inhale as the handles rise back up, and exhale as you pull them down toward your chest.

name: Reverse Grip Pull-Up
description:
A vertical bodyweight pulling exercise with palms facing you, emphasizing the lats and biceps.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grab the bar with palms facing you (supinated grip), hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Hang with arms fully extended and scapula engaged.
3. Pull your chest up towards the bar, leading with your elbows.
4. Clear your chin above the bar, squeezing at the top.
5. Lower yourself back to the starting position with control.

Подсказки по технике: Chest to bar; Elbows drive down; No swinging; Full arm extension

Распространённые ошибки: Not extending arms; Using momentum; Craning neck over bar

Дыхание: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Lat Pulldown
description:
A cable pulldown variation using an underhand (supinated) grip to emphasize the lower lats and biceps.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the cable bar attachment and sit with knees secured under the pad.
2. Grasp the bar with a reverse (supinated) shoulder-width grip.
3. Lean back slightly, chest up, arms fully extended.
4. Pull the bar down to your upper chest by contracting your lats.
5. Slowly return the bar to the start position with control.

Подсказки по технике: Pull elbows down; Keep chest up; Don’t swing the torso; Grip the bar tightly

Распространённые ошибки: Using too much momentum; Letting shoulders round; Leaning too far back

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return up.

name: Ring High Row
description:
A suspended horizontal pulling movement using rings set high to target upper back and rear shoulder muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust rings to chest height and grip handles with neutral grip.
2. Lean back with feet forward and body straight.
3. Engage core, keep arms extended.
4. Row your chest toward the rings, retracting shoulder blades.
5. Lower body back to start under control.

Подсказки по технике: Squeeze shoulder blades; Keep body aligned; Control each rep; Pull elbows high

Распространённые ошибки: Sagging hips; Shrugging shoulders; Elbows flaring excessively; Incomplete range

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.

name: Rotational Push-Up
description:
A push-up variation involving a torso rotation to challenge the chest, shoulders, triceps, and core.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Begin in a standard push-up position.
2. Lower your chest toward the floor.
3. As you press up, rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
4. Hold briefly, keeping hips square.
5. Return to start, repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Rotate from torso; Stack shoulders; Keep core tight; Breathe evenly

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips sag; Twisting too fast; Losing shoulder alignment

Дыхание: Exhale when pushing up and rotating, inhale when lowering.

name: Runner's Stretch
description:
A flexibility exercise targeting the hip flexors and hamstrings by stepping one leg forward into a deep lunge.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping the rear leg extended.
2. Place both hands on either side of the front foot.
3. Lower your hips gently, keeping back leg straight.
4. Lift your chest for deeper stretch.
5. Hold, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back leg long; Sink hips down; Lift chest; Square your hips

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knee go over toes; Dropping hips too low; Arching the back excessively

Дыхание: Inhale as you get into position, exhale as you deepen the stretch.

name: Running
description:
A repetitive aerobic movement that improves cardiovascular fitness and endurance.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Warm up with light walking or dynamic stretches.
2. Begin running at a moderate pace.
3. Maintain a steady breathing rhythm and upright posture.
4. Land lightly with a midfoot or forefoot strike.
5. Cool down with walking and stretching.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Relax shoulders; Lean slightly forward from ankles; Swing arms naturally

Распространённые ошибки: Overstriding; Hunching shoulders; Landing heavily on heels

Дыхание: Exhale steadily as you push off, inhale as you recover.

name: Russian Twist on Stability Ball (Arms Straight)
originalName: Russian Twist on Stability Ball (Arms Straight)
description:
An advanced core exercise targeting the obliques by rotating the torso while balanced on a stability ball with arms extended.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a stability ball and walk feet forward until shoulders rest on the ball.
2. Keep knees bent at 90 degrees, hips lifted in a bridge position.
3. Extend arms straight toward the ceiling with hands together.
4. Rotate torso and arms as one unit to the left.
5. Return to center, then rotate to the right, repeating for reps.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms extended; Engage core; Move smoothly; Avoid sagging hips

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips drop; Bending arms; Rotating too quickly

Дыхание: Exhale during each rotation, inhale as you return to center.

name: Scapula Dips
description:
A bodyweight shoulder-blade dip on straight arms that trains scapular control and shoulder depression in a supported position.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Start in a straight-arm support on parallel bars or dip bars with your elbows locked and shoulders stacked over your hands.
2. Lift your chest and brace your trunk while keeping your legs still under you.
3. Lower your body a few inches by letting your shoulders rise toward your ears without bending your elbows.
4. Press down through your hands to pull your shoulders away from your ears and raise your body back up.
5. Repeat with slow, controlled shoulder movement while keeping your arms straight the whole time.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows locked; Shoulders away from ears; Move only at shoulders; Stay tall through chest

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the elbows like a regular dip; Swinging the legs or torso to create momentum; Shrugging up and never pressing back down; Dropping too far and losing shoulder control

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower into the shoulder shrug, and exhale as you press down to lift your body back up.

name: Seated Alternating Dumbbell Curl
description:
A seated exercise curling dumbbells alternately to build bicep size and strength.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with back against support and feet flat.
2. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
3. Curl one dumbbell while rotating palm up.
4. Lower to starting position and alternate arms.
5. Repeat, keeping back straight and elbows close to sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows stationary; Rotate palm up during curl; Don't swing weights; Engage your core

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Elbows flaring; Rocking the torso; Moving both arms together

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Seated Bent Over Back Stretch
description:
A static stretch performed while seated, bending forward to lengthen the lower and upper back muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit comfortably on the floor, legs extended or crossed.
2. Hinge forward at the hips, keeping back relaxed.
3. Let arms reach forward toward feet or floor.
4. Lower your chest toward your knees, breathing deeply.
5. Hold the stretch and relax into the position.

Подсказки по технике: Relax neck; Hinge at hips; Keep stretch gentle; Breathe deeply

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding excessively; Forcing stretch; Holding breath

Дыхание: Inhale before bending, exhale as you fold forward.

name: Seated Boat Stretch
description:
A seated flexibility stretch focusing on the inner thighs and hips.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the floor with back straight.
2. Bring soles of feet together and let knees drop out.
3. Hold ankles or feet for support.
4. Gently pull feet closer and lean forward slightly.
5. Hold position without bouncing.

Подсказки по технике: Keep chest up; Relax knees toward floor; Avoid rounding back; Go only as far as comfortable

Распространённые ошибки: Forcing knees down; Hunching shoulders; Bouncing during stretch

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and regularly while holding the stretch.

name: Seated Cable Row (V-Grip)
description:
A compound cable exercise targeting the mid-back and lats using a V-grip handle.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on the cable row machine and place feet on the foot platform.
2. Grab the V-grip handle with both hands, arms extended.
3. Maintain a straight back and slight knee bend.
4. Pull the handle toward your abdomen, retracting your shoulder blades.
5. Slowly extend arms to return to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back straight; Drive elbows back; Retract shoulder blades; Don’t lean or round spine

Распространённые ошибки: Hunching the back; Using momentum; Allowing elbows to flare out

Дыхание: Exhale as you row back, inhale as you extend forward.

name: Seated Cable Row (Wide-Grip)
description:
A cable row variation using a wide grip to target the upper back and rear deltoids.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit down and place feet against the platform.
2. Grasp the wide grip attachment with both hands.
3. Keep your torso upright, arms fully extended.
4. Pull the handle toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your upper back.
5. Slowly release back to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows high; Squeeze shoulder blades; Keep back neutral; Don’t rock the torso

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning back too far; Letting elbows drop; Rounding the back

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you extend arms.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
description:
A stretch performed while seated, focusing on lengthening the calf muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with legs extended straight in front.
2. Loop a towel or band around one foot's ball.
3. Keep knee straight and pull your toes toward you.
4. Hold position, feeling stretch in calf.
5. Repeat on the other leg.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knee straight; Flex ankle back; Sit up tall; Don't force the stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the knee; Rounding the back; Pulling toes too forcefully

Дыхание: Breathe steadily and deeply throughout the stretch.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description:
A pressing movement targeting the shoulders, performed seated with dumbbells.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench with back support and feet flat.
2. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows bent.
3. Press dumbbells overhead until arms are extended.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower dumbbells to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back pressed to pad; Do not arch lower back; Press overhead; Elbows under wrists

Распространённые ошибки: Arching back excessively; Lowering weights too fast; Letting elbows drop too low; Pressing weights out in front

Дыхание: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
description:
A gentle forward reaching stretch to relieve tension in the lower back while seated.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with legs extended or crossed.
2. Reach both arms straight in front of you.
3. Slowly bend at your hips to lower your torso forward.
4. Relax your back and shoulders.
5. Hold stretch, then return to upright position.

Подсказки по технике: Reach with both arms; Relax neck and head; Hinge from hips; Breathe and relax deeper

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding upper back excessively; Forcing the stretch; Holding breath

Дыхание: Inhale deeply before bending, exhale as you reach forward.

name: Seated Shoulder Flexor, Depressor, Retractor Stretch
originalName: Seated Shoulder Flexor, Depressor, Retractor Stretch
description:
A seated stretch focusing on improving flexibility and mobility in the front, lower, and rear shoulder muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit tall with feet flat.
2. Lift arms overhead, reaching upward.
3. Gently depress the shoulders away from your ears.
4. Retract shoulder blades by pulling them slightly together.
5. Hold for a stretch, breathing evenly.

Подсказки по технике: Reach up; Pull shoulders down; Retract shoulder blades; Keep chest open

Распространённые ошибки: Shrugging shoulders; Hunching forward; Holding breath

Дыхание: Inhale to begin, exhale as you stretch deeper.

name: Seated Straight Arm Twist
description:
Seated torso rotation with arms straight to target the obliques and core stability.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with knees bent, feet either flat or off the ground.
2. Extend arms straight forward, clasping hands.
3. Lean back slightly with a neutral spine.
4. Rotate torso to one side, arms following movement.
5. Return to center and repeat to opposite side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arms straight; Brace your core; Rotate shoulders not just arms; Don't round your lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Using just arms instead of rotating the torso; Rounding the spine; Moving too quickly or without control

Дыхание: Exhale as you twist, inhale returning to center.

name: Seated Twist on Stability Ball
description:
A rotational core exercise performed while seated on a stability ball to target the obliques.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a stability ball with feet flat, core engaged.
2. Hold arms in front or across chest.
3. Rotate your torso to the right, keeping hips stationary.
4. Pause, then twist to the left.
5. Return to center, repeat alternately.

Подсказки по технике: Sit tall; Keep hips steady; Rotate from the waist; Engage core

Распространённые ошибки: Slouching; Over-rotating hips; Forgetting to brace core

Дыхание: Exhale during the twist, inhale as you return to center.

name: Seated Twist Stretch (Straight Arm)
description:
A flexibility exercise involving seated trunk rotation to stretch the obliques and lower back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit upright with legs extended forward.
2. Cross your left leg over your right if desired for more stretch.
3. Extend your right arm straight behind you for support.
4. Twist your torso toward your right, using the opposite arm for leverage.
5. Hold, then repeat to the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back straight; Twist gently; Look over shoulder; Breathe deeply

Распространённые ошибки: Slouching the back; Over-twisting; Holding breath

Дыхание: Breathe steadily while holding the stretch.

name: Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
description:
A sequence of stretches performed in a wide-legged seated position to improve hip, hamstring, and lower back flexibility.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit with legs extended wide apart.
2. Keep knees and toes pointing upward.
3. Sit tall and hinge forward at hips.
4. Walk hands forward, maintaining flat back.
5. Hold stretch or gently move side to side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep spine long; Point toes up; Lead with chest; Don't round lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees roll inward; Rounding back excessively; Pushing too far

Дыхание: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you stretch forward.

name: Shoulder-Width Pull-Up
description:
A classic bodyweight exercise targeting the lats and upper back with a shoulder-width overhand grip.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Grip bar shoulder-width, palms away.
2. Hang with arms fully extended.
3. Pull up until chin clears the bar.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower down slowly to full extension.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with chest; No swinging; Full range of motion; Elbows down and back

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Partial reps; Shrugging shoulders

Дыхание: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.

name: Side Bend on Stability Ball
description:
A lateral flexion movement performed on a stability ball to target the obliques.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Position yourself sideways on a stability ball, feet braced.
2. Place top hand behind head, other hand for balance.
3. Lower your torso over the ball for a stretch.
4. Contract your side to lift torso up in a side bend.
