5. Lower back down with control, repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips stacked; Engage obliques; Avoid pulling neck; Slow movement

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Rotating torso; Not stabilizing with lower arm

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.

name: Side Bend Stretch
description:
A standing lateral bending stretch focusing on lengthening the obliques and side body muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand or sit tall with spine neutral.
2. Raise right arm overhead.
3. Slowly bend torso to the left, keeping hips steady.
4. Hold stretch for time, feeling the pull in your side.
5. Return to start and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips level; Reach upward first; Don’t twist; Bend directly sideways

Распространённые ошибки: Twisting trunk; Tilting forward/backward; Dropping shoulder

Дыхание: Exhale as you bend, inhale as you return to upright.

name: Side Plank
description:
A core-strengthening hold performed on one side, engaging the obliques and stabilizing hip muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your side, elbow stacked under shoulder.
2. Stack your feet or place one in front of the other.
3. Raise hips up to create a straight line.
4. Hold body in line, keeping abs and glutes engaged.
5. Lower hips gently to finish; switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep body straight; Elbow directly under shoulder; Squeeze glutes; Don't let hips sag

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips drop; Shoulder collapsing inward; Twisting upper body

Дыхание: Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
description:
A standing or seated stretch for the wrist and forearm, involving lateral arm extension and gentle pulling.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand or sit tall.
2. Extend one arm overhead or outward.
3. Hold your wrist with the opposite hand.
4. Pull gently toward one side.
5. Hold, then switch sides.

Подсказки по технике: Keep arm straight; Pull gently; Relax shoulder; Keep hips squared

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling too hard; Locking elbow; Shrugging shoulder

Дыхание: Exhale as you stretch, inhale to reset or switch sides.

name: Single Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description:
A stiff-legged deadlift variation using a single dumbbell to target the hamstrings and lower back.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright holding a dumbbell with both hands at your thighs.
2. Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
3. Hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the floor.
4. Pause at the bottom while feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Return to the upright position by driving hips forward.

Подсказки по технике: Hips back; Flat back; Feel hamstring stretch; No rounding

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding back; Excessive knee bend; Bouncing at bottom

Дыхание: Inhale lowering, exhale as you stand back up.

name: Single Leg Stretch (Bent Knee)
description:
A floor stretch to target hip flexors and hamstrings by pulling one bent leg towards the chest.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with both legs bent.
2. Grasp one knee with both hands.
3. Pull the knee toward your chest gently.
4. Hold the stretch, keeping your back flat.
5. Switch sides and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep shoulders relaxed; Pull gently; Keep opposite foot on floor; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Overpulling knee; Arching lower back; Holding breath

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the knee in, inhale as you release.

name: Single Straight Leg Stretch
description:
A floor stretch focusing on the hamstrings by raising and holding one straight leg toward the body.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with both legs straight.
2. Lift one leg up while keeping it straight.
3. Hold the back of your thigh or calf gently.
4. Pull the leg slightly toward your chest.
5. Hold and switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Keep leg straight; Relax neck and shoulders; Point or flex foot for deeper stretch; Avoid pulling too hard

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the raised knee; Lifting hips off mat; Straining neck or back

Дыхание: Exhale as you stretch the leg, inhale as you lower it.

name: Sit-Up
description:
A classic abdominal exercise that lifts the torso upward from a lying position.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie down with knees bent and feet flat.
2. Cross arms over chest or place hands behind head.
3. Engage your core and raise your torso towards your knees.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Slowly lower back to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lead with chest; Avoid pulling neck; Move with control; Keep feet flat

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling on neck; Arching lower back; Using momentum

Дыхание: Exhale on the ascent, inhale on the descent.

name: Sit-Up
description:
A classic ab exercise involving lifting the torso from the floor to a seated position to build core strength.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet anchored.
2. Place hands behind your head or across your chest.
3. Engage your core to lift your torso to a seated position.
4. Pause at the top, then slowly lower back to the floor.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Подсказки по технике: Avoid pulling on neck; Lift chest first; Engage abs throughout; Control the lower

Распространённые ошибки: Jerking the neck; Using momentum; Feet lifting off the ground

Дыхание: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.

name: Sled 45 Degree Calf Press
description:
A seated calf exercise on a 45-degree sled where you press through the balls of your feet to raise and lower the heels.

Оборудование: sled machine

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and place the balls of both feet on the lower edge of the platform with your heels hanging off.
2. Straighten your legs enough to support the sled and keep a small bend in your knees.
3. Let your heels drop down by bending at the ankles until you feel a stretch in your calves.
4. Press through the balls of your feet and raise your heels as high as you can.
5. Pause briefly at the top while keeping your legs steady.
6. Lower your heels under control back to the stretched position and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Drive through the balls of feet; Lift heels as high as possible; Control the heel drop; Keep knees softly bent

Распространённые ошибки: Bending and straightening the knees instead of moving only at the ankles; Placing the whole foot flat on the platform so the heels cannot drop; Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control; Turning the toes excessively in or out during the rep

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press through the balls of your feet to raise them.

name: Sled 45 Degree Wide Leg Press
description:
A compound lower body movement targeting the quadriceps with emphasis on glutes and adductors due to a wide foot stance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the seat and load desired weight.
2. Sit with your back and head against the pad, feet flat and wide on the platform.
3. Release the safety handles and grasp the side handles.
4. Bend your knees to lower the platform until your thighs reach 90 degrees or just past.
5. Press through your heels to extend your legs fully, but avoid locking out the knees.

Подсказки по технике: Push through heels; Keep knees in line with toes; Do not lock knees at top; Maintain flat lower back

Распространённые ошибки: Allowing knees to collapse inward; Rounding lower back; Half reps or short range; Locking knees at extension

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the platform, exhale as you press it back up.

name: Sled Hack Squat
description:
A machine squat on an angled sled with your back supported to train the quads, glutes, and legs through a controlled range.

Оборудование: sled machine

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand on the sled platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the pads.
2. Place your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform with toes turned slightly out, then grip the handles.
3. Unlock the sled and lower yourself by bending your knees and hips until your thighs reach parallel or your deepest controlled position.
4. Keep your full foot planted against the platform as your knees track in line with your toes.
5. Drive through your heels and midfoot to extend your knees and hips and return the sled upward.
6. Stop just short of locking your knees, then continue into the next repetition.

Подсказки по технике: Keep your back on pad; Knees track over toes; Push through whole foot; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Feet placed too low so the heels lift off the platform; Knees collapsing inward during the lowering phase; Lower back rounding or hips peeling off the pad; Bouncing out of the bottom instead of pausing briefly

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the sled, then exhale as you press it back up.

name: Smith Chair Squat
description:
A Smith machine squat variation that targets the quads while training the glutes and hamstrings through a controlled bar path.

Оборудование: тренажёр Смита

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the Smith bar across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of the bar path.
2. Unrack the bar and brace your core with your chest up and eyes forward.
3. Bend your knees and hips together to sit straight down under control.
4. Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor or slightly below while keeping your heels down.
5. Drive through your midfoot and heels to stand back up until your knees and hips are fully extended.
6. Lock out tall, then repeat for the next rep.

Подсказки по технике: Chest up; Knees track over toes; Drive through heels; Brace your core

Распространённые ошибки: Feet set directly under the bar so the knees travel too far forward.; Heels lift off the floor at the bottom.; Knees cave inward during the ascent.; Lower back rounds as the hips drop.

Дыхание: Inhale and brace before you lower, then exhale as you drive back up to standing.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
description:
A standing calf raise using a Smith machine to isolate and strengthen the calf muscles.

Оборудование: тренажёр Смита

Техника выполнения:
1. Set up the Smith machine bar at shoulder height.
2. Step under the bar, position it across your upper traps, and unrack.
3. Stand upright with feet hip to shoulder-width apart.
4. Rise onto the balls of your feet by extending your ankles.
5. Pause at the top, then lower your heels in a controlled manner.

Подсказки по технике: Move only at ankles; Keep legs straight (but not locked); Control the movement; Pause at top

Распространённые ошибки: Bouncing for momentum; Partial range of motion; Allowing ankles to roll outward/inward

Дыхание: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
description:
A guided barbell deadlift performed with a Smith machine to build lower back, glutes, and hamstrings strength.

Оборудование: тренажёр Смита

Техника выполнения:
1. Position feet shoulder-width beneath the Smith bar.
2. Grip the bar just outside your knees with both hands.
3. Hinge hips back and lower torso, keeping chest up.
4. Extend hips and knees to lift the bar along the guides.
5. Lower the bar with control to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Hinge at hips; Keep back flat; Drive through heels; Bar close to shins

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back; Lifting with arms instead of legs; Letting the bar drift away from body; Jerky movements

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you lift.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
description:
A machine-based variation of leg press performed with a Smith machine barbell in a supine or incline position.

Оборудование: тренажёр Смита

Техника выполнения:
1. Set the safety stops and load the appropriate weight.
2. Lie under the Smith bar and position feet wider than shoulder-width on the bar.
3. Unrack the bar by rotating your feet upward.
4. Lower the bar slowly toward your torso until legs form roughly a 90-degree angle.
5. Press the bar up by extending your knees and hips.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core braced; Press evenly with both feet; Full range of motion; Maintain foot flatness

Распространённые ошибки: Incorrect foot placement; Pressing with toes only; Shallow movement; Letting knees cave inward

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you press upward.

name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
description:
A seated overhead press on a Smith machine that trains the delts and triceps with a fixed bar path.

Оборудование: тренажёр Смита

Техника выполнения:
1. Set a bench or seat under the Smith bar so the bar starts around shoulder height when you sit down.
2. Sit tall with your back supported, plant your feet flat, and grip the bar just wider than shoulder width with palms forward.
3. Unrack the bar and hold it above your upper chest with wrists stacked over elbows.
4. Lower the bar in a straight path until it reaches about chin to shoulder level.
5. Press the bar straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
6. Lower the bar with control to the start position and repeat.
7. Finish by locking out the top and rotating the bar to re-rack it on the hooks.

Подсказки по технике: Keep ribs down; Press straight up; Wrists stacked over elbows; Feet flat and braced

Распространённые ошибки: Lowering the bar behind the head; Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides; Arching the lower back off the bench; Letting the wrists bend back excessively

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower the bar to shoulder level, and exhale as you press it overhead.

name: Spell Caster
description:
A standing dumbbell core move where you hinge and rotate side to side, reaching the weight toward each foot to train the obliques.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell with both hands in front of your hips.
2. Soften your knees and hinge slightly at your hips while keeping your chest up and back flat.
3. Rotate your torso and lower the dumbbell toward the outside of one foot.
4. Drive through your hips and return to the center with the dumbbell back in front of your hips.
5. Rotate to the other side and lower the dumbbell toward the outside of the opposite foot.
6. Continue alternating sides with controlled movement.

Подсказки по технике: Rotate through your torso; Keep your back flat; Bend at the hips; Move with control

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the lower back as the dumbbell lowers; Bending mostly through the spine instead of hinging at the hips; Letting the knees cave inward during the reach; Swinging the dumbbell quickly instead of controlling each side

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower and rotate toward one foot, then exhale as you return to center and switch sides.

name: Spine Stretch
description:
A floor stretch focusing on lengthening the spine and improving flexibility in the lower back and hamstrings.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on floor with legs extended and feet flexed.
2. Extend arms straight ahead at shoulder height.
3. Inhale, then as you exhale, reach forward, articulating your spine.
4. Stretch forward as far as comfortable, keeping legs straight.
5. Hold and return slowly to start.

Подсказки по технике: Lengthen spine; Reach with fingertips; Keep legs straight; Relax neck

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding shoulders excessively; Forcing the stretch; Bending knees

Дыхание: Exhale as you stretch forward, inhale as you return to start.

name: Squat
description:
A foundational lower body movement that strengthens the quads, glutes, and hamstrings by bending and straightening the knees and hips.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly outward.
2. Brace core and keep chest up.
3. Initiate movement by pushing hips back and bending knees.
4. Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
5. Push through heels to return to standing.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knees tracking toes; Maintain neutral spine; Weight on midfoot/heels; Chest up

Распространённые ошибки: Letting knees collapse inward; Rounding lower back; Not reaching parallel depth

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you stand up.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
description:
A hamstring-focused curl using a stability ball for both resistance and core engagement.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie face up on the floor, arms at your sides, heels on a stability ball.
2. Lift hips to form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
3. Bend knees to roll the ball toward your glutes.
4. Pause and squeeze your hamstrings.
5. Extend your legs to roll the ball back out.

Подсказки по технике: Hips up; Control movement; Don’t let hips sag; Engage core

Распространённые ошибки: Letting hips drop; Rapid reps; Not extending legs fully

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl in, inhale as you extend out.

name: Stability Ball Leg Elevated Crunch
description:
A crunch variation where the legs rest on a stability ball, increasing core engagement and instability.

Оборудование: фитбол

Техника выполнения:
1. Place stability ball in front of you and sit down.
2. Lie back and position your calves and feet on top of the ball with knees bent.
3. Place your hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.
4. Engage your core and curl your upper body toward your knees.
5. Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down without losing control.

Подсказки по технике: Keep lower back pressed to floor; Do not pull with your neck; Control the movement; Exhale on lift

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum instead of muscle; Straining the neck; Letting the ball roll away; Arching the lower back

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Stairs Calf Stretch
description:
A stretch performed using stairs to lengthen and increase flexibility in the calf muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or stair.
2. Support yourself with a railing, wall, or sturdy object.
3. Lower your heels slowly below the step to feel a stretch in your calves.
4. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
5. Raise heels back up and repeat as desired.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knees straight but not locked; Lower heels gradually; Engage core for balance; Avoid bouncing

Распространённые ошибки: Letting heels drop too fast; Rounding your back; Bouncing during stretch

Дыхание: Exhale as you lower into the stretch, inhale as you return.

name: Standing Adductor Stretch
description:
A static stretch targeting the inner thighs by lunging to the side and holding.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand wide with feet apart.
2. Shift weight to one leg, bending at the knee.
3. Keep the opposite leg straight and toes forward.
4. Lean gently toward the bent knee for a deep inner thigh stretch.
5. Hold, then switch to the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep both heels on floor; Maintain upright torso; Do not bounce; Stretch slowly

Распространённые ошибки: Letting the heel lift; Twisting hips; Bending forward at the waist

Дыхание: Breathe deeply and steadily while holding the stretch.

name: Standing Back Rotation Stretch
description:
A standing twisting stretch targeting the obliques and rotational muscles of the back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Extend arms at shoulder height or place hands on hips.
3. Rotate torso gently to one side without moving hips.
4. Hold stretch for desired time.
5. Return to center and repeat on other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips facing forward; Rotate gently; Elongate spine; Don’t force stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Over-rotating; Letting hips twist; Holding breath

Дыхание: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.

name: Standing Bench Calf Stretch
description:
A static stretch using a bench to lengthen the calf muscles.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand in front of a bench or sturdy surface.
2. Place the ball of one foot onto the edge, keeping heel on the floor.
3. Lean your body forward while keeping your knee straight.
4. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
5. Switch legs and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep knee straight; Lean from the hips; Maintain upright posture; Feel stretch in calf, not ankle

Распространённые ошибки: Bending the knee too much; Letting the foot roll inward or outward; Forcing the stretch

Дыхание: Exhale as you relax into the stretch, inhale as you ease off.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
description:
A static stretch targeting the hamstring muscles along the back of the upper leg.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand up straight with feet hip-width apart.
2. Keep knees soft, and hinge forward at the hips.
3. Lower your torso toward your legs while reaching for your toes.
4. Stop when you feel a gentle stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Hold for the desired duration, then return to standing.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back straight; Hinge from hips; Avoid locking knees; Don't bounce

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding the back; Locking out the knees; Forcing the stretch

Дыхание: Exhale as you hinge forward, inhale as you return upright.

name: Standing Hip Flexor and Abdominal Stretch
originalName: Standing Hip Flexor and Abdominal Stretch
description:
A standing stretch focusing on opening the hips and lengthening the abdominal muscles by reaching overhead and leaning back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Lift arms overhead, palms facing forward.
3. Arch back gently, lifting chest and looking upward.
4. Shift hips forward slightly to increase hip flexor stretch.
5. Hold and breathe for desired duration.

Подсказки по технике: Engage glutes; Stretch upwards before leaning back; Don’t force neck back; Keep knees soft

Распространённые ошибки: Overarching lower back; Locking knees; Failing to engage core

Дыхание: Inhale before arching; exhale as you hold the stretch.

name: Standing Knee Raise Stretch
description:
A stretch that targets the hip flexors and glutes by pulling one knee toward the chest while standing.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet together.
2. Lift one knee toward your chest.
3. Grasp your knee with both hands.
4. Pull the knee gently toward your chest, feeling the stretch.
5. Hold, then lower and repeat on the opposite leg.

Подсказки по технике: Keep torso upright; Engage core; Use arms to pull knee gently; Do not lean back

Распространённые ошибки: Rounding shoulders; Pulling too forcefully; Losing balance

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the knee up, inhale as you release.

name: Standing Lateral Stretch
description:
A standing side-bending stretch to target the obliques and lengthen the muscles along the side of the torso.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright, feet hip-width apart.
2. Raise one arm overhead, keeping it straight.
3. Place other hand on hip or let it hang at side.
4. Gently lean to the opposite side, keeping hips square.
5. Hold, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Reach tall, then over; Keep both feet grounded; Hips facing forward; Breathe into stretch

Распространённые ошибки: Rotating torso; Bending forward or backwards; Not keeping arm straight

Дыхание: Inhale to lengthen, exhale as you lean into the stretch.

name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
description:
A standing stretch that targets the quadriceps for improved flexibility.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand upright, balancing on one foot.
2. Bend the opposite knee, reaching back for the foot.
3. Pull heel gently towards glute while keeping knees together.
4. Keep torso tall and hips level.
5. Hold the stretch, then switch legs.

Подсказки по технике: Knees side by side; Torso tall; Engage core; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Knees apart; Leaning forward; Pulling foot too aggressively

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull heel in, inhale as you release.

name: Standing Reach Up Back Rotation Stretch
originalName: Standing Reach Up Back Rotation Stretch
description:
A dynamic stretch involving reaching overhead and rotating to open up the chest and upper back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Raise both arms overhead.
3. Gently arch your upper back and chest.
4. Rotate your torso to one side while maintaining the stretch.
5. Return to center, then rotate to the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core engaged; Avoid hyperextending lower back; Reach up and out; Move smoothly

Распространённые ошибки: Overarching the lower back; Not fully extending arms; Twisting too abruptly

Дыхание: Inhale before reaching up; exhale as you rotate and stretch.

name: Standing Side Bend Stretch (Bent Arm)
description:
A side bending stretch performed while standing to lengthen the obliques and lats.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Raise one arm overhead, bending the elbow comfortably.
3. Lean sideways away from the raised arm to stretch the side of your torso.
4. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
5. Switch sides and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Keep hips square; Bend without twisting; Stretch through the side; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Rotating the torso; Overextending; Holding breath

Дыхание: Breathe deeply throughout the stretch.

name: Standing Wheel Rollout
description:
An advanced rollout exercise that stretches and strengthens the abdominals, chest, shoulders, and back.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ab wheel.
2. Bend forward and place the wheel on the floor in front of your feet.
3. Roll the wheel forward, extending your arms and torso while keeping your core tight.
4. Lower your body until you're just above the floor, maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
5. Reverse the motion by pulling the wheel back toward your feet, returning to the start.

Подсказки по технике: Engage core strongly; Do not let hips sag; Keep arms straight; Move slowly and with control

Распространённые ошибки: Letting lower back arch excessively; Collapsing hips; Bending elbows during rollout

Дыхание: Inhale as you roll out, exhale as you pull back in.

name: Stationary Bike
description:
A cardio exercise performed while seated, pedaling a stationary machine to boost heart rate and endurance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Set seat and handlebar to appropriate heights.
2. Sit upright and grip the handlebars lightly.
3. Place feet securely on the pedals.
4. Begin pedaling at a comfortable resistance and pace.
5. Continue for your intended duration, maintaining good form.

Подсказки по технике: Keep back straight; Drive through full pedal stroke; Relax shoulders; Maintain steady breathing

Распространённые ошибки: Slouching forward; Bouncing in the seat; Pedaling with toes only; Setting seat too low/high

Дыхание: Breathe evenly and deeply throughout the session.

name: Straight-Leg Up Crunch
description:
A crunch variant with straight legs held vertically to challenge upper abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on back, legs straight up, feet flexed.
2. Place arms beside you or hands behind head.
3. Engage core, lift head and shoulders toward legs.
4. Pause at top, exhale.
5. Lower down with control.

Подсказки по технике: Chin tucked; Reach toward ceiling; Don't strain neck; Slow movement

Распространённые ошибки: Jerking up; Using momentum; Flaring elbows

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Supine Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description:
A biceps isolation curl performed lying face up for strict form and minimal cheating.

Оборудование: гантели

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back holding dumbbells at your sides, arms fully extended.
2. Keep palms facing forward (supinated grip).
3. Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, elbows stationary.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Lower the weights slowly to the start position.

Подсказки по технике: Upper arms still; Don’t arch back; Full stretch at bottom; Slow negative

Распространённые ошибки: Lifting shoulders off bench; Swinging arms; Partial range

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Treadmill Running
description:
A popular form of indoor cardiovascular exercise performed at varying intensities on a treadmill machine.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Step onto the treadmill and position feet on the sides.
2. Select preferred speed and incline.
3. Begin running, holding onto the handrails if necessary for balance.
4. Focus on smooth strides and upright posture.
5. Cool down by gradually reducing speed before stopping.

Подсказки по технике: Keep posture upright; Land softly; Don't overstride; Use arm swing for balance

Распространённые ошибки: Holding handrails too long; Slouching; Overstriding; Staring down

Дыхание: Inhale through nose, exhale through mouth in rhythm with strides.

name: Triceps Dips
description:
A bodyweight exercise that targets the triceps through a pressing motion while lowering and raising the body.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Sit on a bench or chair with hands gripping the edge.
2. Extend legs forward and slide hips off the seat.
3. Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees.
4. Press through palms to straighten arms and lift body.
5. Repeat for reps.

Подсказки по технике: Keep elbows close to your body; Lower slowly; Press through your palms; Avoid shrugging shoulders

Распространённые ошибки: Letting shoulders roll forward; Dropping hips too low; Elbows flaring out

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you push up.

name: Twisting Crunch
description:
A crunch variation with a rotation to engage the obliques and upper abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
2. Place hands lightly behind your head.
3. Crunch up, twisting your torso to bring one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
4. Return to start and repeat to the other side.
5. Alternate sides for each repetition.

Подсказки по технике: Twist from the torso; Elbow toward knee; Avoid pulling neck; Keep lower back down

Распространённые ошибки: Pulling on the head/neck; Not rotating enough; Lifting lower back

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch and twist, inhale as you return.

name: V-Up
description:
A dynamic core exercise where both legs and torso are lifted to meet in a 'V' position, activating the abdominals.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
2. Engage your core to lift your legs and torso simultaneously.
3. Reach your hands toward your feet at the top, forming a 'V' shape.
4. Pause briefly, squeezing your abs.
5. Lower down slowly to starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Lift with abs; Keep legs straight; Reach toward toes; Control the descent

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging legs; Arching lower back; Not fully engaging abs

Дыхание: Exhale when lifting up, inhale as you lower down.

name: Vertical Leg Raise (on parallel bars)
description:
A bodyweight core exercise on parallel bars where you raise straight legs in front of you under control.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Support yourself on the parallel bars with straight arms and your legs hanging together.
2. Pull your shoulders down and brace your midsection to stop your body from swinging.
3. Keep your knees straight and lift your legs forward in front of you.
4. Raise your legs until they reach hip height or slightly higher.
5. Pause briefly at the top without leaning back.
6. Lower your legs with control to the start and reset before the next repetition.

Подсказки по технике: Keep legs straight; Brace and stop the swing; Lift with control; Shoulders down

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to start each rep; Bending the knees as the legs rise; Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears; Dropping the legs quickly on the way down

Дыхание: Exhale as you lift your legs, then inhale as you lower them back to the start.

name: Walk Wave Machine
description:
A low-impact cardio machine utilizing a unique lateral gliding motion to engage lower body muscles and improve endurance.

Оборудование: рычажный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Step onto the machine and position feet on pedals.
2. Grip handles for stability.
3. Initiate movement by pushing one leg outward while the other follows.
4. Maintain a rhythmic, lateral gliding motion.
5. Continue for the desired time or intensity.

Подсказки по технике: Maintain upright posture; Engage glutes; Move laterally; Use smooth, controlled motion

Распространённые ошибки: Leaning forward; Letting knees cave in; Jerky movements

Дыхание: Keep breath steady and controlled throughout.

name: Weighted Leg Extension Crunch
description:
A core exercise combining a crunch with a resisted leg extension to engage the abdominals.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie flat on your back with knees bent, holding a weight across your chest.
2. Lift your legs to tabletop position (knees over hips, 90-degree bend).
3. Simultaneously extend your legs outward and crunch your upper body up.
4. Pause briefly at peak contraction.
5. Return arms and legs to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Keep core braced; Don't arch lower back; Control leg extension; Crunch chest up

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum; Letting lower back arch; Holding breath

Дыхание: Exhale as you crunch and extend, inhale as you return.

name: Weighted Lying Twist
description:
A core rotational movement that targets the obliques using added resistance.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Lie on your back with arms outstretched for support.
2. Hold a weight between your feet (or over chest).
3. Lift your legs up to a 90-degree angle.
4. Slowly rotate your legs to one side, keeping shoulders down.
5. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

Подсказки по технике: Keep shoulders grounded; Move slowly and controlled; Engage obliques; Don’t swing legs

Распространённые ошибки: Letting shoulders lift; Using momentum; Dropping legs too low

Дыхание: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
description:
A quad-focused squat variation done on the balls of the feet with a backward torso lean while holding added weight.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and hold the weight securely in front of your chest or across your upper back.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet and brace your midsection.
3. Lean your torso back in one straight line from knees to shoulders as your knees travel forward.
4. Lower under control by bending your knees until you feel a strong stretch through the front of your thighs.
5. Drive through the balls of your feet and straighten your knees to return to the start.
6. Finish tall and reset your balance before the next repetition.

Подсказки по технике: Lean back as one piece; Keep hips extended; Drive knees forward; Stay on your toes

Распространённые ошибки: Bending forward at the hips during the descent; Dropping the heels and shifting weight backward; Letting the knees cave inward; Lowering too fast and bouncing out of the bottom

Дыхание: Inhale as you lower under control, then exhale as you drive back up to the starting position.

name: Weighted Standing Curl
description:
A standing biceps exercise where you curl weights from your sides up toward your shoulders with palms facing forward.

Оборудование: weighted

Техника выполнения:
1. Stand tall with a weight in each hand at your sides and turn your palms forward.
2. Set your feet about hip-width apart and keep your elbows pinned near your ribs.
3. Curl the weights upward by bending your elbows until your hands reach shoulder height.
4. Pause briefly at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
5. Lower the weights back down with control until your arms are fully straightened at your sides.

Подсказки по технике: Elbows stay by your sides; Curl, don't swing; Palms face forward; Lower with control

Распространённые ошибки: Swinging the torso to lift the weights; Letting the elbows drift forward at the top; Dropping the weights quickly on the way down; Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral

Дыхание: Exhale as you curl the weights up, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

name: Wide Grip Cable Lat Pulldown
description:
A cable exercise performed with a wide grip that primarily targets the latissimus dorsi to build back width and upper body strength.

Оборудование: блочный тренажёр

Техника выполнения:
1. Adjust the thigh pad and sit at the cable pulldown machine.
2. Grip the wide bar overhead with a pronated (overhand) grip, hands wider than shoulders.
3. Lean back slightly, brace your core, and retract your shoulder blades.
4. Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving elbows down and out.
5. Pause briefly, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.

Подсказки по технике: Pull elbows down; Keep chest up; Don't swing; Control the weight

Распространённые ошибки: Using momentum or body swing; Allowing shoulders to shrug up; Not fully extending arms; Pulling bar behind neck

Дыхание: Exhale as you pull the bar down, inhale as you return to start.

name: Wrist Circles
description:
A warm-up and mobility exercise to increase wrist flexibility and circulation in the forearms.

Оборудование: собственный вес

Техника выполнения:
1. Extend arms out in front or to sides.
2. Make fists or keep hands open.
3. Slowly rotate wrists in circular motions.
4. Perform several circles in one direction.
5. Switch direction and repeat.

Подсказки по технике: Move slowly; Full range of motion; Stay relaxed; Breathe steadily

Распространённые ошибки: Moving arms instead of wrists; Rushing motions; Holding breath

Дыхание: Breathe evenly throughout the movement.
